<file path="scripts/build-sidecar.sh">
 1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
 2: set -euo pipefail
 3: 
 4: SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
 5: REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
 6: SIDECAR_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/src-tauri/sidecar"
 7: BINARIES_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/src-tauri/binaries"
 8: 
 9: # Resolve Rust target triple for the current machine
10: TARGET=$(rustc --print host-target 2>/dev/null || python3 -c "
11: import platform
12: m = platform.machine()
13: s = platform.system()
14: if s == 'Darwin':
15:     print('aarch64-apple-darwin' if m == 'arm64' else 'x86_64-apple-darwin')
16: elif s == 'Windows':
17:     print('x86_64-pc-windows-msvc')
18: else:
19:     print('x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu')
20: ")
21: 
22: echo "▶ Building sidecar for target: $TARGET"
23: 
24: # PyInstaller — venv 우선, 없으면 PATH (CI: pip install pyinstaller 후 사용)
25: cd "$SIDECAR_DIR"
26: PYINSTALLER="$SIDECAR_DIR/.venv/bin/pyinstaller"
27: if [ ! -f "$PYINSTALLER" ]; then
28:     PYINSTALLER="$SIDECAR_DIR/venv/bin/pyinstaller"
29: fi
30: if [ ! -f "$PYINSTALLER" ]; then
31:     PYINSTALLER=$(command -v pyinstaller 2>/dev/null || true)
32: fi
33: if [ -z "$PYINSTALLER" ]; then
34:     echo "❌ PyInstaller not found. Run: cd src-tauri/sidecar && python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install pyinstaller -r requirements.txt"
35:     exit 1
36: fi
37: 
38: "$PYINSTALLER" sidecar.spec --distpath "$SIDECAR_DIR/dist" --workpath "$SIDECAR_DIR/build" --noconfirm
39: 
40: # Copy binary to src-tauri/binaries/ with Tauri-expected name
41: mkdir -p "$BINARIES_DIR"
42: SRC="$SIDECAR_DIR/dist/sidecar"
43: DEST="$BINARIES_DIR/sidecar-$TARGET"
44: 
45: if [[ "$TARGET" == *"windows"* ]]; then
46:     SRC="$SRC.exe"
47:     DEST="$DEST.exe"
48: fi
49: 
50: cp "$SRC" "$DEST"
51: echo "✅ sidecar binary → $DEST"
</file>

<file path="src/entities/bean/api.ts">
 1: import { supabase } from '@shared/lib/supabase';
 2: import type { Bean, Database } from '@shared/types/database.types';
 3: 
 4: type BeanInsert = Database['public']['Tables']['beans']['Insert'];
 5: type BeanUpdate = { id: string } & Database['public']['Tables']['beans']['Update'];
 6: 
 7: export const beanApi = {
 8:     list: async (userId: string): Promise<Bean[]> => {
 9:         const { data, error } = await supabase
10:             .from('beans')
11:             .select('*')
12:             .eq('user_id', userId)
13:             .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
14:         if (error) throw error;
15:         return data || [];
16:     },
17: 
18:     get: async (id: string): Promise<Bean> => {
19:         const { data, error } = await supabase.from('beans').select('*').eq('id', id).single();
20:         if (error) throw error;
21:         return data!;
22:     },
23: 
24:     create: async (bean: BeanInsert): Promise<Bean> => {
25:         const { data, error } = await supabase.from('beans').insert(bean).select().single();
26:         if (error) throw error;
27:         return data!;
28:     },
29: 
30:     update: async ({ id, ...patch }: BeanUpdate): Promise<Bean> => {
31:         const { data, error } = await supabase.from('beans').update(patch).eq('id', id).select().single();
32:         if (error) throw error;
33:         return data!;
34:     },
35: 
36:     delete: async (id: string): Promise<void> => {
37:         const { error } = await supabase.from('beans').delete().eq('id', id);
38:         if (error) throw error;
39:     },
40: };
</file>

<file path="src/entities/bean/queries.ts">
 1: import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
 2: import { beanApi } from './api'
 3: import type { Bean } from '../../shared/types/database.types'
 4: 
 5: export const beanKeys = {
 6:     all: (userId: string) => ['beans', userId] as const,
 7:     detail: (id: string) => ['beans', 'detail', id] as const,
 8: }
 9: 
10: export const useBeans = (userId: string) =>
11:     useQuery({
12:         queryKey: beanKeys.all(userId),
13:         queryFn: () => beanApi.list(userId),
14:         enabled: !!userId,
15:     })
16: 
17: export const useBean = (id: string) =>
18:     useQuery({
19:         queryKey: beanKeys.detail(id),
20:         queryFn: () => beanApi.get(id),
21:         enabled: !!id,
22:     })
23: 
24: export const useCreateBean = (userId: string) => {
25:     const qc = useQueryClient()
26:     return useMutation({
27:         mutationFn: beanApi.create,
28:         onSuccess: (newBean) => {
29:             qc.setQueryData<Bean[]>(beanKeys.all(userId), (prev = []) => [newBean, ...prev])
30:         },
31:     })
32: }
33: 
34: export const useUpdateBean = (userId: string) => {
35:     const qc = useQueryClient()
36:     return useMutation({
37:         mutationFn: beanApi.update,
38:         onSuccess: (updated) => {
39:             qc.setQueryData<Bean[]>(beanKeys.all(userId), (prev = []) =>
40:                 prev.map((b) => (b.id === updated.id ? updated : b))
41:             )
42:             qc.setQueryData(beanKeys.detail(updated.id), updated)
43:         },
44:     })
45: }
46: 
47: export const useDeleteBean = (userId: string) => {
48:     const qc = useQueryClient()
49:     return useMutation({
50:         mutationFn: beanApi.delete,
51:         onMutate: async (id) => {
52:             await qc.cancelQueries({ queryKey: beanKeys.all(userId) })
53:             const prev = qc.getQueryData<Bean[]>(beanKeys.all(userId))
54:             qc.setQueryData<Bean[]>(beanKeys.all(userId), (old = []) => old.filter((b) => b.id !== id))
55:             return { prev }
56:         },
57:         onError: (_err, _id, ctx) => {
58:             if (ctx?.prev) qc.setQueryData(beanKeys.all(userId), ctx.prev)
59:         },
60:         onSuccess: (_data, id) => {
61:             qc.removeQueries({ queryKey: beanKeys.detail(id) })
62:         },
63:     })
64: }
</file>

24:         return data!;
25:     },

28:         const { data, error } = await supabase.from('bean_inventory_logs').update(patch).eq('id', id).select().single();
29:         if (error) throw error;
30:         return data!;
31:     },
32: 
33:     delete: async (id: string): Promise<void> => {

36:     },
37: };

<file path="src/entities/bean-inventory/queries.ts">
 1: import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
 2: import { beanInventoryApi } from './api'
 3: import type { BeanInventoryLog } from '../../shared/types/database.types'
 4: 
 5: export const beanInventoryKeys = {
 6:     all: (userId: string) => ['inventory_logs', userId] as const,
 7:     byBean: (userId: string, beanId: string) => ['inventory_logs', userId, beanId] as const,
 8: }
 9: 
10: export const useBeanInventoryLogs = (userId: string, beanId?: string) =>
11:     useQuery({
12:         queryKey: beanId ? beanInventoryKeys.byBean(userId, beanId) : beanInventoryKeys.all(userId),
13:         queryFn: () => beanInventoryApi.list(userId, beanId),
14:         enabled: !!userId,
15:     })
16: 
17: export const useCreateBeanInventoryLog = (userId: string) => {
18:     const qc = useQueryClient()
19:     return useMutation({
20:         mutationFn: beanInventoryApi.create,
21:         onSuccess: (newLog) => {
22:             qc.setQueryData<BeanInventoryLog[]>(beanInventoryKeys.all(userId), (prev = []) => [newLog, ...prev])
23:             if (newLog.bean_id) {
24:                 qc.setQueryData<BeanInventoryLog[]>(
25:                     beanInventoryKeys.byBean(userId, newLog.bean_id),
26:                     (prev = []) => [newLog, ...prev]
27:                 )
28:             }
29:             if (newLog.type === 'purchase') {
30:                 qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['beans', userId] })
31:             }
32:         },
33:     })
34: }
35: 
36: export const useUpdateBeanInventoryLog = (userId: string, beanId?: string) => {
37:     const qc = useQueryClient()
38:     return useMutation({
39:         mutationFn: beanInventoryApi.update,
40:         onSuccess: (updated) => {
41:             const patch = (prev: BeanInventoryLog[] = []) =>
42:                 prev.map((l) => (l.id === updated.id ? updated : l))
43: 
44:             qc.setQueryData<BeanInventoryLog[]>(beanInventoryKeys.all(userId), patch)
45:             if (beanId) {
46:                 qc.setQueryData<BeanInventoryLog[]>(beanInventoryKeys.byBean(userId, beanId), patch)
47:             }
48:         },
49:     })
50: }
51: 
52: export const useDeleteBeanInventoryLog = (userId: string, beanId?: string) => {
53:     const qc = useQueryClient()
54:     return useMutation({
55:         mutationFn: beanInventoryApi.delete,
56:         onSuccess: (_, id) => {
57:             const remove = (prev: BeanInventoryLog[] = []) => prev.filter((l) => l.id !== id)
58: 
59:             qc.setQueryData<BeanInventoryLog[]>(beanInventoryKeys.all(userId), remove)
60:             if (beanId) {
61:                 qc.setQueryData<BeanInventoryLog[]>(beanInventoryKeys.byBean(userId, beanId), remove)
62:             }
63:         },
64:     })
65: }
</file>

<file path="src/entities/machine/model.ts">
 1: import { create } from 'zustand';
 2: import { persist } from 'zustand/middleware';
 3: import type { Machine } from './types';
 4: 
 5: const uid = (): string => `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
 6: 
 7: export const VIRTUAL_ID = '__virtual__';
 8: 
 9: const VIRTUAL_MACHINE: Machine = {
10:     id: VIRTUAL_ID,
11:     name: 'Virtual Machine',
12:     roasterKey: 'virtual',
13:     displayName: 'Virtual Machine',
14:     brand: 'Internal',
15:     models: ['가상 머신'],
16:     protocol: 'virtual',
17:     connectionParams: {},
18:     capabilities: [],
19:     pid: null,
20:     createdAt: '2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
21: };
22: 
23: interface MachinesState {
24:     machines: Machine[];
25:     addMachine: (draft: Omit<Machine, 'id' | 'createdAt'>) => Machine;
26:     removeMachine: (id: string) => void;
27:     updateMachine: (id: string, patch: Partial<Machine>) => void;
28: }
29: 
30: export const useMachines = create<MachinesState>()(
31:     persist(
32:         (set) => ({
33:             machines: [VIRTUAL_MACHINE],
34: 
35:             addMachine: (draft) => {
36:                 const machine: Machine = {
37:                     ...draft,
38:                     id: uid(),
39:                     createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
40:                 };
41:                 set((s) => ({ machines: [...s.machines, machine] }));
42:                 return machine;
43:             },
44: 
45:             removeMachine: (id) => {
46:                 if (id === VIRTUAL_ID) return;
47:                 set((s) => ({ machines: s.machines.filter((m) => m.id !== id) }));
48:             },
49: 
50:             updateMachine: (id, patch) => {
51:                 set((s) => ({
52:                     machines: s.machines.map((m) => (m.id === id ? { ...m, ...patch } : m)),
53:                 }));
54:             },
55:         }),
56:         {
57:             name: 'fc_machines',
58:             partialize: (state) => ({
59:                 machines: state.machines.filter((m) => m.id !== VIRTUAL_ID),
60:             }),
61:             merge: (persisted, current) => ({
62:                 ...current,
63:                 machines: [VIRTUAL_MACHINE, ...((persisted as { machines: Machine[] }).machines ?? [])],
64:             }),
65:         },
66:     ),
67: );
</file>

 1: import type { TemperatureUnit } from '../model/settings';
 2: 
 3: export const toDisplayTemp = (celsius: number, unit: TemperatureUnit): number =>
 4:     unit === 'F' ? celsius * 9 / 5 + 32 : celsius;
 5: 
 6: export const formatTemp = (celsius: number | null, unit: TemperatureUnit): string =>
 7:     celsius == null ? '—' : `${toDisplayTemp(celsius, unit).toFixed(1)}°${unit}`;
 8: 
 9: /** RoR는 델타 온도 단위 — °F/min = °C/min × 9/5 */
10: export const toDisplayRoR = (cPerMin: number, unit: TemperatureUnit): number =>
11:     unit === 'F' ? cPerMin * 9 / 5 : cPerMin;

1: /** "M:SS" 형식의 시간 문자열을 초 단위 정수로 변환한다. */
2: export const parseTimeSec = (t: string): number => {
3:     const [m, s] = t.split(':').map(Number);
4:     return (m || 0) * 60 + (s || 0);
5: };

<file path="src/features/active-roast/lib/turningPoints.ts">
 1: export interface TurningPoint {
 2:     timeSec: number;
 3:     temp: number;
 4: }
 5: 
 6: const SMOOTH_WINDOW = 7;
 7: const MIN_VALID_POINTS = 15;
 8: const TP_LOOKBACK_SEC = 30;
 9: 
10: const movingAvg = (data: number[], w: number): number[] => {
11:     const half = Math.floor(w / 2);
12:     return data.map((_, i) => {
13:         let sum = 0, count = 0;
14:         for (let j = Math.max(0, i - half); j <= Math.min(data.length - 1, i + half); j++) {
15:             sum += data[j]; count++;
16:         }
17:         return count > 0 ? sum / count : 0;
18:     });
19: };
20: 
21: const centralDiff = (xs: number[], ys: number[]): number[] =>
22:     ys.map((_, i) => {
23:         if (i === 0) return (ys[1] - ys[0]) / Math.max(1e-9, xs[1] - xs[0]);
24:         if (i === ys.length - 1) return (ys[i] - ys[i - 1]) / Math.max(1e-9, xs[i] - xs[i - 1]);
25:         return (ys[i + 1] - ys[i - 1]) / Math.max(1e-9, xs[i + 1] - xs[i - 1]);
26:     });
27: 
28: export const detectTurningPoints = (xs: number[], bt: number[]): TurningPoint[] => {
29:     if (xs.length < MIN_VALID_POINTS) return [];
30: 
31:     // Double smooth to suppress noise before differentiating
32:     const smoothed = movingAvg(movingAvg(bt, SMOOTH_WINDOW), SMOOTH_WINDOW);
33:     const d1 = centralDiff(xs, smoothed);
34: 
35:     const points: TurningPoint[] = [];
36: 
37:     for (let i = 2; i < xs.length - 2; i++) {
38:         // TP: 1st derivative neg → pos  (BT local minimum)
39:         if (d1[i - 1] < -0.01 && d1[i + 1] > 0.01) {
40:             // 스무딩 lag 보정: 탐지 시점 직전 LOOKBACK_SEC 구간에서 실제 최솟값 역추적
41:             const lookbackStart = xs[i] - TP_LOOKBACK_SEC;
42:             let minTemp = Infinity;
43:             let minTimeSec = xs[i];
44:             for (let j = i; j >= 0 && xs[j] >= lookbackStart; j--) {
45:                 if (bt[j] < minTemp) {
46:                     minTemp = bt[j];
47:                     minTimeSec = xs[j];
48:                 }
49:             }
50:             points.push({ timeSec: minTimeSec, temp: minTemp });
51:             break; // TP는 로스팅당 한 번만
52:         }
53:     }
54: 
55:     return points;
56: };
</file>

<file path="src/features/active-roast/model/useAutoDetection.ts">
  1: import { useRef, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
  2: 
  3: import { useRoastingStore } from './status';
  4: import { detectTurningPoints } from '@features/active-roast';
  5: import type { TurningPoint } from '@features/active-roast';
  6: 
  7: const AUTO_CHARGE_WINDOW = 5;
  8: 
  9: const AUTO_DROP_DROP_C = 8;
 10: const AUTO_DROP_WINDOW = 5;
 11: const AUTO_DROP_MIN_ELAPSED_S = 180;
 12: 
 13: export const useAutoDetection = (
 14:     livePoints: { time: number; bt: number }[],
 15:     onAutoCharge: (bt: number) => void,
 16:     onAutoDrop: () => void,
 17:     onTurningPoint: (tp: TurningPoint) => void,
 18:     autoChargeDropC: number = 5,
 19: ) => {
 20:     const btWindowRef = useRef<number[]>([]);
 21:     const dropWindowRef = useRef<number[]>([]);
 22:     const autoChargedRef = useRef(false);
 23:     const autoDroppedRef = useRef(false);
 24:     const tpFiredRef = useRef(false);
 25: 
 26:     const [confirmedTP, setConfirmedTP] = useState<TurningPoint | null>(null);
 27: 
 28:     const phase = useRoastingStore((s) => s.phase);
 29:     const elapsed = useRoastingStore((s) => s.elapsed);
 30:     const liveData = useRoastingStore((s) => s.liveData);
 31:     const bt = liveData?.bt ?? null;
 32: 
 33:     // Auto Charge
 34:     useEffect(() => {
 35:         if (phase !== 'standby' || bt == null || autoChargedRef.current) return;
 36: 
 37:         btWindowRef.current = [...btWindowRef.current.slice(-(AUTO_CHARGE_WINDOW - 1)), bt];
 38: 
 39:         if (btWindowRef.current.length >= AUTO_CHARGE_WINDOW) {
 40:             const first = btWindowRef.current[0];
 41:             const last = btWindowRef.current[btWindowRef.current.length - 1];
 42:             if (first - last >= autoChargeDropC) {
 43:                 autoChargedRef.current = true;
 44:                 onAutoCharge(bt);
 45:             }
 46:         }
 47:     }, [phase, bt, onAutoCharge]);
 48: 
 49:     // Auto Drop
 50:     useEffect(() => {
 51:         if (phase !== 'roasting' || bt == null || autoDroppedRef.current) return;
 52:         if (elapsed < AUTO_DROP_MIN_ELAPSED_S) return;
 53: 
 54:         dropWindowRef.current = [...dropWindowRef.current.slice(-(AUTO_DROP_WINDOW - 1)), bt];
 55: 
 56:         if (dropWindowRef.current.length >= AUTO_DROP_WINDOW) {
 57:             const first = dropWindowRef.current[0];
 58:             const last = dropWindowRef.current[dropWindowRef.current.length - 1];
 59:             if (first - last >= AUTO_DROP_DROP_C) {
 60:                 autoDroppedRef.current = true;
 61:                 onAutoDrop();
 62:             }
 63:         }
 64:     }, [phase, bt, elapsed, onAutoDrop]);
 65: 
 66:     // Turning Point detection
 67:     const detectedTPs = useMemo(() => {
 68:         if (phase !== 'roasting' || livePoints.length < 15) return [];
 69:         return detectTurningPoints(
 70:             livePoints.map((p) => p.time),
 71:             livePoints.map((p) => p.bt),
 72:         );
 73:     }, [phase, livePoints]);
 74: 
 75:     // Lock in confirmedTP on first detection (no setState in useMemo)
 76:     useEffect(() => {
 77:         if (confirmedTP !== null || detectedTPs.length === 0) return;
 78:         setConfirmedTP(detectedTPs[0]);
 79:     }, [detectedTPs, confirmedTP]);
 80: 
 81:     // Fire callback exactly once
 82:     useEffect(() => {
 83:         if (confirmedTP === null || tpFiredRef.current) return;
 84:         tpFiredRef.current = true;
 85:         onTurningPoint(confirmedTP);
 86:     }, [confirmedTP, onTurningPoint]);
 87: 
 88:     const turningPoints = confirmedTP !== null ? [confirmedTP] : detectedTPs;
 89: 
 90:     // Manual charge를 누를 때 호출해 auto-charge race 방지
 91:     const disableAutoCharge = useCallback(() => {
 92:         autoChargedRef.current = true;
 93:     }, []);
 94: 
 95:     const resetAutoDetection = useCallback(() => {
 96:         btWindowRef.current = [];
 97:         dropWindowRef.current = [];
 98:         autoChargedRef.current = false;
 99:         autoDroppedRef.current = false;
100:         tpFiredRef.current = false;
101:         setConfirmedTP(null);
102:     }, []);
103: 
104:     return {
105:         resetAutoDetection,
106:         disableAutoCharge,
107:         turningPoints,
108:         confirmedTP,
109:     };
110: };
</file>

<file path="src/shared/data/roast-mock-data.ts">
 1: import type { RoastPoint } from '../types/roast';
 2: 
 3: const generateFullRoastData = (): RoastPoint[] => {
 4:     const points: RoastPoint[] = [];
 5:     for (let t = 0; t <= 780; t += 15) {
 6:         const min = t / 60;
 7:         let bt: number;
 8: 
 9:         if (t <= 90) {
10:             bt = 200 - (48 * t) / 90;
11:         } else if (t <= 180) {
12:             bt = 152 + (4 * (t - 90)) / 90;
13:         } else if (t <= 420) {
14:             bt = 156 + (18 * (t - 180)) / 240;
15:         } else if (t <= 660) {
16:             bt = 174 + (19 * (t - 420)) / 240;
17:         } else {
18:             bt = 193 + (10 * (t - 660)) / 120;
19:         }
20: 
21:         const et = t === 0 ? 220 : t <= 90 ? 220 - (5 * t) / 90 : 215 + Math.sin(t / 300) * 0.8;
22: 
23:         let ror = 0;
24:         if (points.length > 0) {
25:             const prev = points[points.length - 1];
26:             ror = (bt - prev.bt) / (15 / 60);
27:             if (t <= 90) ror = 0;
28:         }
29: 
30:         points.push({
31:             time: t,
32:             label: `${Math.floor(min)}:${String(Math.round((min % 1) * 60)).padStart(2, '0')}`,
33:             bt: Math.round(bt * 10) / 10,
34:             et: Math.round(et * 10) / 10,
35:             ror: Math.max(0, Math.round(ror * 10) / 10),
36:         });
37:     }
38:     return points;
39: }
40: 
41: export const fullData: RoastPoint[] = generateFullRoastData();
</file>

<file path="src/shared/i18n/index.ts">
 1: import i18n from 'i18next';
 2: import { initReactI18next } from 'react-i18next';
 3: import { locale } from '@tauri-apps/plugin-os';
 4: import { LazyStore } from '@tauri-apps/plugin-store';
 5: import ko from './locales/ko.json';
 6: import en from './locales/en.json';
 7: import ja from './locales/ja.json';
 8: import zhCN from './locales/zh-CN.json';
 9: 
10: export const supportedLanguages = ['ko', 'en', 'ja', 'zh-CN'] as const;
11: export type SupportedLanguage = (typeof supportedLanguages)[number];
12: 
13: const LANGUAGE_KEY = 'language';
14: const LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY = 'fc.language';
15: 
16: const store = new LazyStore('settings.json');
17: 
18: const normalizeLanguage = (value: string | null | undefined): SupportedLanguage => {
19:   const normalized = value?.toLowerCase();
20:   if (normalized?.startsWith('ko')) return 'ko';
21:   if (normalized?.startsWith('ja')) return 'ja';
22:   if (normalized?.startsWith('zh')) return 'zh-CN';
23:   if (normalized?.startsWith('en')) return 'en';
24:   return 'en';
25: };
26: 
27: const getStoredLanguage = async (): Promise<string | undefined> => {
28:   try {
29:     return await store.get<string>(LANGUAGE_KEY);
30:   } catch {
31:     return window.localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY) ?? undefined;
32:   }
33: };
34: 
35: const getSystemLanguage = async (): Promise<string | null> => {
36:   try {
37:     return await locale();
38:   } catch {
39:     return window.navigator.language;
40:   }
41: };
42: 
43: const persistLanguage = async (language: SupportedLanguage) => {
44:   try {
45:     await store.set(LANGUAGE_KEY, language);
46:     await store.save();
47:   } catch {
48:     window.localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY, language);
49:   }
50: };
51: 
52: export const setLanguage = async (language: SupportedLanguage) => {
53:   await i18n.changeLanguage(language);
54:   document.documentElement.lang = language;
55:   await persistLanguage(language);
56: };
57: 
58: export const initI18n = async () => {
59:   const savedLanguage = await getStoredLanguage();
60:   const language = normalizeLanguage(savedLanguage ?? await getSystemLanguage());
61: 
62:   await i18n.use(initReactI18next).init({
63:     lng: language,
64:     fallbackLng: 'en',
65:     supportedLngs: supportedLanguages,
66:     resources: {
67:       ko: { translation: ko },
68:       en: { translation: en },
69:       ja: { translation: ja },
70:       'zh-CN': { translation: zhCN },
71:     },
72:     interpolation: { escapeValue: false },
73:   });
74: 
75:   document.documentElement.lang = language;
76: 
77:   if (!savedLanguage) {
78:     await persistLanguage(language);
79:   }
80: };
81: 
82: export { i18n };
</file>

<file path="src/shared/lib/format.ts">
 1: export const sanitizeDecimal = (v: string) =>
 2:     v.replace(/[^\d.]/g, '').replace(/(\..*)\./g, '$1');
 3: 
 4: export const formatDuration = (seconds: number | null): string => {
 5:     if (seconds == null) return '—';
 6:     const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
 7:     const s = Math.round(seconds % 60);
 8:     return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
 9: };
10: 
11: export const formatDate = (iso: string | null): string => {
12:     if (!iso) return '—';
13:     const d = new Date(iso);
14:     return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
15: };
16: 
17: export const formatDateShort = (iso: string | null): string => {
18:     if (!iso) return '—';
19:     return iso.slice(5, 10);
20: };
21: 
22: export const pctChange = (current: number, previous: number): string => {
23:     if (previous === 0) return current > 0 ? '+∞%' : '0%';
24:     const diff = ((current - previous) / previous) * 100;
25:     return `${diff >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${Math.round(diff)}%`;
26: };
27: 
28: export const durationDiff = (current: number, previous: number): string => {
29:     const diff = Math.round(current - previous);
30:     return `${diff >= 0 ? '+' : '-'}${formatDuration(Math.abs(diff))}`;
31: };
</file>

<file path="src/shared/store/auth.ts">
 1: import { create } from 'zustand';
 2: import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
 3: import type { User } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
 4: 
 5: type Plan = 'free' | 'pro' | 'team';
 6: 
 7: interface AuthState {
 8:     user: User | null;
 9:     plan: Plan;
10:     loading: boolean;
11: }
12: 
13: interface AuthActions {
14:     /** App 최상단에서 한 번 호출. 반환값은 cleanup 함수. */
15:     init: () => () => void;
16:     /** Email + Password 로그인. 실패 시 에러 throw. */
17:     signInWithEmail: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
18:     /** 로그아웃 */
19:     signOut: () => Promise<void>;
20: }
21: 
22: export const useAuthStore = create<AuthState & AuthActions>((set, get) => ({
23:     user: null,
24:     plan: 'free',
25:     loading: true,
26: 
27:     init: () => {
28:         // 5초 안에 auth 응답 없으면 강제로 loading 해제 (토큰 refresh hang 방어)
29:         const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
30:             if (get().loading) set({ user: null, plan: 'free', loading: false });
31:         }, 5000);
32: 
33:         // onAuthStateChange는 동기 콜백이어야 함 — async 사용 금지
34:         // Supabase v2: subscribe 시점에 INITIAL_SESSION으로 즉시 발화
35:         const {
36:             data: { subscription },
37:         } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_, session) => {
38:             clearTimeout(timeout);
39: 
40:             const next = session?.user ?? null;
41:             if (get().user?.id === next?.id && !get().loading) return;
42: 
43:             // loading은 즉시 해제 — plan은 백그라운드에서 업데이트
44:             set({ user: next, plan: 'free', loading: false });
45: 
46:             if (next) {
47:                 void (async () => {
48:                     try {
49:                         const { data } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('plan').eq('id', next.id).single();
50:                         if (data?.plan) set({ plan: data.plan as Plan });
51:                     } catch (e) {
52:                         console.warn('[auth] plan fetch failed:', e);
53:                     }
54:                 })();
55:             }
56:         });
57: 
58:         return () => {
59:             clearTimeout(timeout);
60:             subscription.unsubscribe();
61:         };
62:     },
63: 
64:     signInWithEmail: async (email, password) => {
65:         const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });
66:         if (error) throw error;
67:     },
68: 
69:     signOut: async () => {
70:         const { error } = await supabase.auth.signOut();
71:         if (error) throw error;
72:         set({ user: null, plan: 'free' });
73:     },
74: }));
75: 
76: /** 현재 유저가 Pro 이상인지 반환 (pro / team 모두 true) */
77: export const selectIsPro = (s: AuthState & AuthActions) => s.plan !== 'free';
</file>

<file path="src/shared/ui/CounterInput.tsx">
 1: import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
 2: import { ChevronUp, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';
 3: import { sanitizeDecimal } from '@shared/lib/format';
 4: 
 5: const inputCls =
 6:     'w-full rounded-xl border border-[rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:border-[#585d61] bg-surface dark:bg-surface-elevated px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[13px] text-primary outline-none focus:border-[rgba(0,0,0,0.2)] shadow-(--shadow-inset)';
 7: 
 8: const labelCls = 'block text-[12px] font-medium text-secondary mb-1.5';
 9: 
10: export const CounterInput = ({
11:     label,
12:     value,
13:     onChange,
14:     placeholder,
15:     step = 0.1,
16: }: {
17:     label: string;
18:     value: string;
19:     onChange: (v: string | ((prev: string) => string)) => void;
20:     placeholder?: string;
21:     step?: number;
22: }) => {
23:     const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
24:     const intervalRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
25: 
26:     const handleAdjust = (delta: number) => {
27:         onChange((prev) => {
28:             const current = parseFloat(prev) || 0;
29:             const next = Math.max(0, Math.round((current + delta) * 100) / 100);
30:             return String(next);
31:         });
32:     };
33: 
34:     const stop = () => {
35:         if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
36:         if (intervalRef.current) clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
37:     };
38: 
39:     const start = (delta: number) => {
40:         stop();
41:         handleAdjust(delta);
42:         timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
43:             intervalRef.current = setInterval(() => handleAdjust(delta), 60);
44:         }, 300);
45:     };
46: 
47:     useEffect(() => stop, []);
48: 
49:     return (
50:         <div>
51:             <label className={labelCls}>{label}</label>
52:             <div className="relative group">
53:                 <input
54:                     className={`${inputCls} pr-10`}
55:                     type="text"
56:                     inputMode="decimal"
57:                     placeholder={placeholder}
58:                     value={value}
59:                     onChange={(e) => onChange(sanitizeDecimal(e.target.value))}
60:                 />
61:                 <div className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex flex-col gap-1">
62:                     <button
63:                         type="button"
64:                         onMouseDown={() => start(step)}
65:                         onMouseUp={stop}
66:                         onMouseLeave={stop}
67:                         className="text-muted/40 hover:text-primary transition-colors outline-none"
68:                     >
69:                         <ChevronUp size={12} strokeWidth={3} />
70:                     </button>
71:                     <button
72:                         type="button"
73:                         onMouseDown={() => start(-step)}

<file path="src/shared/ui/ErrorBoundary.tsx">
 1: import { Component, type ReactNode } from 'react';
 2: import { QueryErrorResetBoundary } from '@tanstack/react-query';
 3: 
 4: interface Props {
 5:     children: ReactNode;
 6:     onReset?: () => void;
 7:     fallback?: (props: { error: Error; reset: () => void }) => ReactNode;
 8: }
 9: 
10: interface State {
11:     error: Error | null;
12: }
13: 
14: export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
15:     state: State = { error: null };
16: 
17:     static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
18:         return { error };
19:     }
20: 
21:     reset = () => {
22:         this.props.onReset?.();
23:         this.setState({ error: null });
24:     };
25: 
26:     render() {
27:         const { error } = this.state;
28: 
29:         if (error) {
30:             if (this.props.fallback) {
31:                 return this.props.fallback({ error, reset: this.reset });
32:             }
33:             return <DefaultErrorFallback error={error} reset={this.reset} />;
34:         }
35: 
36:         return this.props.children;
37:     }
38: }
39: 
40: const DefaultErrorFallback = ({ error, reset }: { error: Error; reset: () => void }) => (
41:     <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full gap-4 p-8 text-center">
42:         <p className="text-sm text-red-400">{error.message || '알 수 없는 오류가 발생했습니다.'}</p>
43:         <button
44:             onClick={reset}
45:             className="px-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-md bg-stone-700 hover:bg-stone-600 text-stone-100 transition-colors"
46:         >
47:             다시 시도
48:         </button>
49:     </div>
50: );
51: 
52: export const ViewErrorBoundary = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => (
53:     <QueryErrorResetBoundary>
54:         {({ reset }) => (
55:             <ErrorBoundary onReset={reset}>
56:                 {children}
57:             </ErrorBoundary>
58:         )}
59:     </QueryErrorResetBoundary>
60: );
</file>

<file path="src/views/dashboard/useWeather.ts">
 1: import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
 2: import { locationStore } from '@shared/lib/locationStore';
 3: 
 4: const WEATHER_TTL = 30 * 60 * 1000;
 5: 
 6: export interface WeatherData {
 7:     temperature: number;
 8:     humidity: number;
 9: }
10: 
11: const fetchOpenMeteo = async (lat: number, lng: number): Promise<WeatherData> => {
12:     const res = await fetch(
13:         `https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast` +
14:         `?latitude=${lat}&longitude=${lng}` +
15:         `&current=temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m`,
16:     );
17:     if (!res.ok) throw new Error('weather fetch failed');
18:     const json = await res.json();
19:     return {
20:         temperature: Math.round(json.current.temperature_2m),
21:         humidity: Math.round(json.current.relative_humidity_2m),
22:     };
23: };
24: 
25: export const useWeather = () => {
26:     const coords = useQuery({
27:         queryKey: ['weather', 'coords'],
28:         queryFn: () => locationStore.get(),
29:         staleTime: Infinity,
30:     });
31: 
32:     const weather = useQuery({
33:         queryKey: ['weather', 'current', coords.data?.lat, coords.data?.lng],
34:         queryFn: () => fetchOpenMeteo(coords.data!.lat, coords.data!.lng),
35:         enabled: !!coords.data,
36:         staleTime: WEATHER_TTL,
37:         retry: 1,
38:     });
39: 
40:     return {
41:         data: weather.data ?? null,
42:         loading: coords.isLoading || weather.isLoading,
43:     };
44: };
</file>

<file path="src/views/useRoastActions.ts">
 1: import { useCallback } from 'react';
 2: import { sidecar } from '@shared/lib/sidecar';
 3: import { formatTemp, type TemperatureUnit, type TurningPoint } from '@features/active-roast';
 4: import { useRoastingStore } from '@features/active-roast/model/status';
 5: import { parseTimeSec } from '@features/active-roast/lib/time';
 6: import type { LogEntry } from '@shared/types/roast';
 7: 
 8: interface UseRoastActionsParams {
 9:     unit: TemperatureUnit;
10:     rawBT: number | null;
11:     setLogEntries: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<LogEntry[]>>;
12:     setIsRunning: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
13:     setShowEndRoastModal: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
14:     storeStartCharge: () => void;
15:     roastStartTimeRef: React.MutableRefObject<number>;
16: }
17: 
18: interface UseRoastActionsReturn {
19:     triggerCharge: (btAtCharge?: number | null) => void;
20:     handleAutoDrop: () => void;
21:     handleTurningPoint: (tp: TurningPoint) => void;
22: }
23: 
24: export const useRoastActions = ({
25:     unit,
26:     rawBT,
27:     setLogEntries,
28:     setIsRunning,
29:     setShowEndRoastModal,
30:     storeStartCharge,
31:     roastStartTimeRef,
32: }: UseRoastActionsParams): UseRoastActionsReturn => {
33:     const triggerCharge = useCallback(
34:         (btAtCharge?: number | null) => {
35:             sidecar.startRoast().catch(() => {});
36:             roastStartTimeRef.current = Date.now();
37:             storeStartCharge();
38:             setIsRunning(true);
39:             const temp = btAtCharge != null ? formatTemp(btAtCharge, unit) : formatTemp(rawBT, unit);
40:             setLogEntries([{ time: '0:00', event: 'Charge', temp, note: 'Bean drop detected' }]);
41:         },
42:         [unit, rawBT, setLogEntries, setIsRunning, storeStartCharge, roastStartTimeRef],
43:     );
44: 
45:     const handleAutoDrop = useCallback(() => {
46:         setLogEntries((prev) => {
47:             if (prev.some((e) => e.event === 'Drop')) return prev;
48:             const elapsed = useRoastingStore.getState().elapsed;
49:             const min2 = Math.floor(elapsed / 60);
50:             const sec2 = elapsed % 60;
51:             return [
52:                 ...prev,
53:                 {
54:                     time: `${min2}:${String(sec2).padStart(2, '0')}`,
55:                     event: 'Drop',
56:                     temp: formatTemp(rawBT, unit),
57:                     note: 'Bean drop detected',
58:                 },
59:             ];
60:         });
61:         setShowEndRoastModal(true);
62:     }, [rawBT, unit, setLogEntries, setShowEndRoastModal]);
63: 
64:     const handleTurningPoint = useCallback(
65:         (tp: TurningPoint) => {
66:             const timeMin = Math.floor(tp.timeSec / 60);
67:             const tpSec = Math.floor(tp.timeSec % 60);
68:             const tpTimeStr = `${timeMin}:${String(tpSec).padStart(2, '0')}`;
69:             setLogEntries((prev) => {
70:                 if (prev.some((e) => e.event === 'TP')) return prev;
71:                 const newEntry = {
72:                     time: tpTimeStr,
73:                     event: 'TP',
74:                     temp: formatTemp(tp.temp, unit),
75:                     note: 'Turning Point detected',
76:                 };
77:                 return [...prev, newEntry].sort((a, b) => parseTimeSec(a.time) - parseTimeSec(b.time));
78:             });
79:         },
80:         [unit, setLogEntries],
81:     );
82: 
83:     return { triggerCharge, handleAutoDrop, handleTurningPoint };
84: };

<file path="src/widgets/active-roast/ui/useMarkerDrag.ts">
 1: import { useRef, type MutableRefObject } from 'react';
 2: import type uPlot from 'uplot';
 3: 
 4: const HIT_PX = 8;
 5: 
 6: export const computeHitThreshSec = (u: uPlot): number => {
 7:     const plotWidCss = u.bbox.width / devicePixelRatio;
 8:     const xRange = ((u.scales.x as uPlot.Scale).max ?? 780) - ((u.scales.x as uPlot.Scale).min ?? 0);
 9:     return (HIT_PX / plotWidCss) * xRange;
10: };
11: 
12: export const useMarkerDrag = (
13:     eventMarkersRef: MutableRefObject<Array<{ timeSec: number; event: string }>>,
14:     onDragRef: MutableRefObject<((event: string, newTimeSec: number) => void) | undefined>,
15: ) => {
16:     const isDraggingRef = useRef(false);
17:     const isNearMarkerRef = useRef(false);
18:     const hoveredMarkerRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
19: 
20:     const setupDrag = (u: uPlot): (() => void) => {
21:         let dragEvent: string | null = null;
22:         let cachedOverRect: DOMRect | null = null;
23: 
24:         const onOverMouseDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
25:             if (e.button !== 0) return;
26:             const cx = u.cursor.left;
27:             if (cx == null) return;
28:             const cursorTimeSec = u.posToVal(cx, 'x');
29:             const thresh = computeHitThreshSec(u);
30:             for (const m of eventMarkersRef.current) {
31:                 if (Math.abs(cursorTimeSec - m.timeSec) <= thresh) {
32:                     dragEvent = m.event;
33:                     isDraggingRef.current = true;
34:                     cachedOverRect = (u.over as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect();
35:                     (u.over as HTMLElement).style.cursor = 'ew-resize';
36:                     e.stopPropagation();
37:                     e.preventDefault();
38:                     return;
39:                 }
40:             }
41:         };
42: 
43:         const onDocMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
44:             if (!dragEvent || !cachedOverRect) return;
45:             const cx = Math.max(0, Math.min(cachedOverRect.width, e.clientX - cachedOverRect.left));
46:             const newTimeSec = Math.max(0, Math.round(u.posToVal(cx, 'x')));
47:             onDragRef.current?.(dragEvent, newTimeSec);
48:         };
49: 
50:         const onDocMouseUp = () => {
51:             if (!dragEvent) return;
52:             (u.over as HTMLElement).style.cursor = '';
53:             dragEvent = null;
54:             cachedOverRect = null;
55:             isDraggingRef.current = false;
56:         };
57: 
58:         u.over.addEventListener('mousedown', onOverMouseDown);
59:         document.addEventListener('mousemove', onDocMouseMove);
60:         document.addEventListener('mouseup', onDocMouseUp);
61: 
62:         return () => {
63:             u.over.removeEventListener('mousedown', onOverMouseDown);
64:             document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onDocMouseMove);
65:             document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onDocMouseUp);
66:         };
67:     };
68: 
69:     return { isDraggingRef, isNearMarkerRef, hoveredMarkerRef, setupDrag };
70: };
</file>

 65: export const AddMachineModal = ({ open, onClose, onAdd }: AddMachineModalProps) => {

 73:     const [testState, setTestState] = useState<TestState>('idle');
 74:     const [testMessage, setTestMessage] = useState('');
 75:     const testConnectedRef = useRef(false);
 76:

 79:     useEffect(() => {

 82:         setParams({});
 83:         setError('');
 84:         setTestState('idle');
 85:         setTestMessage('');
 86:         testConnectedRef.current = false;
 87:         sidecar.getSerialPorts().catch(() => []).then((ports) => setSerialPorts(ports as SerialPort[]));
 88:     }, [open]);
 89: 
 90:     const handleClose = async () => {
 91:         if (testConnectedRef.current) {
 92:             await sidecar.disconnect().catch(() => null);
 93:             testConnectedRef.current = false;
 94:         }
 95:         onClose();
 96:     };
 97: 
 98:     useEffect(() => {
 99:         if (!open) return;
100:         const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
101:             if (e.key === 'Escape') handleClose();
102:         };
103:         window.addEventListener('keydown', handler);
104:         return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handler);
105:     }, [open]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
106: 
107:     useEffect(() => {
108:         if (!selectedKey || !ROASTER_REGISTRY[selectedKey]) return;

110:         const initial: Record<string, string> = {};
111:         for (const field of def.form_fields) {
112:             const defaultVal = def.default_params[field.key];
113:             initial[field.key] = defaultVal != null ? String(defaultVal) : '';
114:         }
115:         setParams(initial);
116:     }, [selectedKey]);
117: 
118:     if (!open) return null;
119:

121:     for (const [key, def] of Object.entries(ROASTER_REGISTRY)) {
122:         if (def.brand === 'Internal') continue;
123:         if (!brands[def.brand]) brands[def.brand] = [];
124:         brands[def.brand].push({ key, def });

129:     const TCP_ONLY = new Set(['host', 'port']);
130:     const RTU_ONLY = new Set(['comport', 'baudrate', 'bytesize', 'parity', 'stopbits']);
131: 
132:     const isFieldVisible = (fieldKey: string): boolean => {
133:         const mode = params['mode']?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
134:         if (!mode) return true;
135:         const isTCP = mode === 'tcp' || mode === 'udp';
136:         const isRTU = mode === 'rtu' || mode === 'serial';
137:         if (TCP_ONLY.has(fieldKey) && isRTU) return false;
138:         if (RTU_ONLY.has(fieldKey) && isTCP) return false;
139:         return true;
140:     };

142:     const buildTypedParams = (): Record<string, unknown> => {

144:         const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
145:         for (const field of selectedDef.form_fields) {
146:             if (!isFieldVisible(field.key)) continue;
147:             const raw = params[field.key];
148:             if (raw === '' || raw == null) continue;
149:             result[field.key] = field.type === 'number' ? Number(raw) : raw;
150:         }
151:         return result;
152:     };
153: 
154:     const validateFields = (): boolean => {

161:             }

163:         return true;

167:         if (!selectedKey || !selectedDef) return;

169:         if (testConnectedRef.current) {

171:             testConnectedRef.current = false;
172:         }
173:

175:         setTestMessage('');
176:         setError('');
177:

179: 
180:         try {

193:         } catch (e) {

<file path="src-tauri/sidecar/adapters/__init__.py">
 1: from adapters.base import Reading
 2: from adapters.virtual import VirtualMachineAdapter
 3: from adapters.kaleido import KaleidoAdapter
 4: from adapters.s7 import S7Adapter
 5: from adapters.modbus import ModbusAdapter
 6: from adapters.probat_ws import ProbatWSAdapter
 7: from adapters.phidget import PhidgetAdapter
 8: from typing import Any
 9: 
10: _PROTOCOL_ADAPTER: dict[str, type] = {
11:     "virtual": VirtualMachineAdapter,
12:     "kaleido": KaleidoAdapter,
13:     "s7": S7Adapter,
14:     "modbus": ModbusAdapter,
15:     "probat_ws": ProbatWSAdapter,
16:     "phidget": PhidgetAdapter,
17: }
18: 
19: 
20: def make_adapter(protocol: str, params: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
21:     cls = _PROTOCOL_ADAPTER.get(protocol)
22:     if cls is None:
23:         raise ValueError(f"지원하지 않는 프로토콜: {protocol}")
24:     return cls(**params)
</file>

<file path="src-tauri/sidecar/adapters/base.py">
 1: import dataclasses
 2: 
 3: 
 4: @dataclasses.dataclass
 5: class Reading:
 6:     bt: float        # Bean Temperature °C  (-1.0 = no data)
 7:     et: float        # Environment Temperature °C
 8:     heater: float    # 0-100
 9:     fan: float       # 0-100
10:     drum: float      # 0-100 (RPM % or raw speed)

<file path="src-tauri/sidecar/roaster_registry.py">
   1: """
   2: roaster_registry.py
   3: ===================
   4: 지원 로스터 브랜드/모델 레지스트리.
   5: 
   6: 새 로스터 추가 방법:
   7:   1. 아래 ROASTER_REGISTRY에 항목 추가
   8:   2. 새 프로토콜인 경우에만 main.py에 Adapter 클래스 추가
   9:   → 프론트엔드 코드 수정 불필요 (GET /roasters로 자동 반영)
  10: 
  11: 프로토콜별 사용 브랜드 레퍼런스 (확장 시 참고)
  12:   s7          → Giesen (W1A~W140A, WxA/WxA+), Probat G/UG (S7 모델)
  13:   kaleido     → Kaleido Network/Serial (kaleido.py 전용 드라이버)
  14:   probat_ws   → Probat WebSocket 모델 (G_UG_WS, P_Series_III, Sample_Roaster)
  15:   modbus      → Probat Probatone, Diedrich CR/DR, Easyster, Proaster, Trinitas
  16:   phidget     → Diedrich Data Logging (id=34), Phidget 장착 범용 로스터
  17:   virtual     → 개발/테스트용 가상 머신
  18:   mqtt        → ROEST (100/200/P3000). 미지원, 추후 MqttAdapter 추가 시 여기에 항목 추가.
  19:   opcua       → 산업용 대형 로스터 일부. 미지원.
  20:   usb_hid     → Aillio R1/R2. 제외 결정.
  21:   async_serial → Hottop. 제외 결정.
  22:   modbus      → Loring Smart Roast (S7/S15/S35/S70/S135). BCD 인코딩, °F 읽기 후 변환 필요.

  24: 출처: artisan/src/includes/Machines/ 각 브랜드별 .aset 파일

<file path="scripts/modbus-sim.py">
  1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
  2: """
  3: MODBUS TCP 시뮬레이터 — 프로덕션 환경에서 하드웨어 연동 테스트용.
  4: 
  5: pymodbus 없이 순수 socket으로 MODBUS TCP 프로토콜 구현.
  6: 사이드카의 ModbusAdapter가 연결하면 실제 와이어 포맷으로 end-to-end 테스트 가능.
  7: 
  8: 사용법:
  9:     src-tauri/sidecar/.venv/bin/python scripts/modbus-sim.py [--port 8502]
 10: 
 11: 연결 설정 (UI에서):
 12:     브랜드: Diedrich / 모델: CR / IP: 127.0.0.1 / Port: 8502 / Mode: tcp
 13: 
 14: 레지스터 맵 (Diedrich CR):
 15:     register 0-1: BT (IEEE 754 float, word_order=little)
 16:     register 4-5: ET (IEEE 754 float, word_order=little)
 17: """
 18: 
 19: import argparse
 20: import logging
 21: import struct
 22: import socket
 23: import threading
 24: import time
 25: 
 26: logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s")
 27: _log = logging.getLogger("modbus-sim")
 28: 
 29: 
 30: # ── 로스팅 프로파일 ────────────────────────────────────────
 31: def _build_profile() -> dict[str, list[float]]:
 32:     times: list[float] = []
 33:     bts: list[float] = []
 34:     ets: list[float] = []
 35:     for t in range(0, 781, 1):
 36:         if t <= 20:
 37:             bt = 200.0 - (22.0 * t) / 20.0
 38:         elif t <= 120:
 39:             bt = 178.0 - (33.0 * (t - 20)) / 100.0
 40:         elif t <= 180:
 41:             bt = 145.0 + (7.0 * (t - 120)) / 60.0
 42:         elif t <= 360:
 43:             bt = 152.0 + (22.0 * (t - 180)) / 180.0
 44:         elif t <= 540:
 45:             bt = 174.0 + (19.0 * (t - 360)) / 180.0
 46:         elif t <= 660:
 47:             bt = 193.0 + (7.0 * (t - 540)) / 120.0
 48:         else:
 49:             bt = 200.0 + (8.0 * (t - 660)) / 120.0
 50: 
 51:         if t <= 30:
 52:             et = 230.0 - (12.0 * t) / 30.0
 53:         elif t <= 90:
 54:             et = 218.0 + (6.0 * (t - 30)) / 60.0
 55:         elif t <= 420:
 56:             et = 224.0 + (10.0 * (t - 90)) / 330.0
 57:         else:
 58:             et = 234.0 + (8.0 * (t - 420)) / 360.0
 59: 
 60:         times.append(float(t))
 61:         bts.append(round(bt, 2))
 62:         ets.append(round(et, 2))
 63:     return {"timex": times, "bt": bts, "et": ets}
 64: 
 65: 
 66: _PROFILE = _build_profile()
 67: _PHASE_DURATION = _PROFILE["timex"][-1]
 68: _start_time = time.monotonic()
 69: 
 70: 
 71: def _noise(scale: float = 0.3) -> float:
 72:     import random
 73:     return (random.random() * 2 - 1) * scale
 74: 
 75: 
 76: def _get_temps() -> tuple[float, float]:
 77:     """현재 시점의 BT/ET 온도 반환."""
 78:     elapsed = time.monotonic() - _start_time
 79:     t = min(elapsed, _PHASE_DURATION)
 80:     idx = int(t)
 81:     if idx >= len(_PROFILE["bt"]):
 82:         idx = len(_PROFILE["bt"]) - 1
 83:     return (
 84:         _PROFILE["bt"][idx] + _noise(0.4),
 85:         _PROFILE["et"][idx] + _noise(0.3),
 86:     )
 87: 
 88: 
 89: def _float_to_regs_le(value: float) -> tuple[int, int]:
 90:     """IEEE 754 float → [low_word, high_word] (little-endian word order)."""
 91:     raw = struct.pack(">f", value)
 92:     low, high = struct.unpack(">HH", raw)
 93:     return low, high
 94: 
 95: 
 96: # ── MODBUS 핸들러 ─────────────────────────────────────────
 97: _MODBUS_FUNCTIONS: dict[int, str] = {
 98:     1: "Read Coils",
 99:     2: "Read Discrete Inputs",
100:     3: "Read Holding Registers",
101:     4: "Read Input Registers",
102: }
103: 
104: 
105: def _handle_request(data: bytes) -> bytes | None:
106:     """MODBUS TCP 요청을 파싱하고 응답을 생성한다."""
107:     if len(data) < 8:
108:         return None
109: 
110:     tid = data[0:2]          # Transaction ID
111:     pid = data[2:4]          # Protocol ID (=0)
112:     # length = data[4:6]     # 남은 바이트 수
113:     unit_id = data[6]        # Unit ID (slave address)
114:     func = data[7]           # Function code
115: 
116:     if func not in (3, 4):   # Read Holding/Input Registers만 처리
117:         _log.warning(f"미지원 function code: {func}")
118:         return tid + pid + bytes([0, 3]) + bytes([unit_id, func | 0x80, 0x01])
119: 
120:     if len(data) < 12:
121:         return None
122: 
123:     start_reg = (data[8] << 8) | data[9]
124:     reg_count = (data[10] << 8) | data[11]
125: 
126:     bt, et = _get_temps()
127:     registers: dict[int, tuple[int, int]] = {
128:         0: _float_to_regs_le(bt),   # BT: register 0-1
129:         4: _float_to_regs_le(et),   # ET: register 4-5
130:     }
131: 
132:     # 요청된 레지스터 범위에 대한 응답 데이터 조립
133:     resp_data = bytearray()
134:     for i in range(start_reg, start_reg + reg_count):
135:         if i in registers:
136:             if i % 2 == 0:
137:                 resp_data.extend(struct.pack(">HH", registers[i][1], registers[i][0]))
138:             else:
139:                 resp_data.extend(struct.pack(">H", 0))
140:         else:
141:             resp_data.extend(struct.pack(">H", 0))
142: 
143:     byte_count = len(resp_data)
144:     length = 2 + byte_count  # unit_id(1) + func(1) + byte_count(1) + data
145:     return tid + pid + struct.pack(">H", length) + bytes([unit_id, func, byte_count]) + resp_data
146: 
147: 
148: # ── TCP 서버 ───────────────────────────────────────────────
149: def _handle_client(conn: socket.socket) -> None:
150:     """클라이언트 연결 처리."""
151:     with conn:
152:         while True:
153:             header = conn.recv(8)
154:             if len(header) < 8:
155:                 break
156:             length = (header[4] << 8) | header[5]
157:             body = conn.recv(length)
158:             if len(body) < length:
159:                 break
160:             resp = _handle_request(header + body)
161:             if resp:
162:                 conn.sendall(resp)
163: 
164: 
165: def main() -> None:
166:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="MODBUS TCP 로스팅 시뮬레이터")
167:     parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8502, help="listen port (default: 8502)")
168:     args = parser.parse_args()
169: 
170:     server = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
171:     server.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
172:     server.bind(("127.0.0.1", args.port))
173:     server.listen(5)
174: 
175:     print(f"🔌 MODBUS 로스팅 시뮬레이터 시작 — 127.0.0.1:{args.port}")
176:     print(f"   레지스터 0-1: BT (float), 레지스터 4-5: ET (float)")
177:     print(f"   13분 로스팅 프로파일 자동 재생 (Ctrl+C 종료)")
178:     print(f"   → UI에서 Diedrich CR, host=127.0.0.1, port={args.port} 로 연결")
179:     print()
180: 
181:     try:
182:         while True:
183:             conn, addr = server.accept()
184:             _log.info(f"연결: {addr}")
185:             t = threading.Thread(target=_handle_client, args=(conn,), daemon=True)
186:             t.start()
187:     except KeyboardInterrupt:
188:         print("\n🛑 시뮬레이터 종료")
189:     finally:
190:         server.close()
191: 
192: 
193: if __name__ == "__main__":
194:     main()

<file path="src/entities/blend/api.ts">
 1: import { supabase } from '@shared/lib/supabase';
 2: import type { Database } from '@shared/types/database.types';
 3: 
 4: export type Blend = Database['public']['Tables']['blends']['Row'];
 5: export type BlendComponent = Database['public']['Tables']['blend_components']['Row'];
 6: 
 7: export type BlendWithComponents = Blend & {
 8:   blend_components: (BlendComponent & { beans: { name: string } })[];
 9: };
10: 
11: type BlendInsert = Database['public']['Tables']['blends']['Insert'];
12: type BlendComponentInsert = Database['public']['Tables']['blend_components']['Insert'];
13: 
14: const SELECT_WITH_COMPONENTS = '*, blend_components(*, beans(name))';
15: 
16: export const blendApi = {
17:   list: async (userId: string): Promise<BlendWithComponents[]> => {
18:     const { data, error } = await supabase
19:       .from('blends')
20:       .select(SELECT_WITH_COMPONENTS)
21:       .eq('user_id', userId)
22:       .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
23:     if (error) throw error;
24:     return (data ?? []) as BlendWithComponents[];
25:   },
26: 
27:   get: async (id: string): Promise<BlendWithComponents> => {
28:     const { data, error } = await supabase
29:       .from('blends')
30:       .select(SELECT_WITH_COMPONENTS)
31:       .eq('id', id)
32:       .single();
33:     if (error) throw error;
34:     return data as BlendWithComponents;
35:   },
36: 
37:   create: async (
38:     blend: BlendInsert,
39:     components: Omit<BlendComponentInsert, 'blend_id'>[],
40:   ): Promise<BlendWithComponents> => {
41:     const { data: newBlend, error: blendErr } = await supabase
42:       .from('blends')
43:       .insert(blend)
44:       .select()
45:       .single();
46:     if (blendErr) throw blendErr;
47: 
48:     const { error: compErr } = await supabase
49:       .from('blend_components')
50:       .insert(components.map((c) => ({ ...c, blend_id: newBlend!.id })));
51:     if (compErr) throw compErr;
52: 
53:     return blendApi.get(newBlend!.id);
54:   },
55: 
56:   update: async (
57:     id: string,
58:     patch: Partial<BlendInsert>,
59:     components: Omit<BlendComponentInsert, 'blend_id'>[],
60:   ): Promise<BlendWithComponents> => {
61:     const { error: blendErr } = await supabase
62:       .from('blends')
63:       .update({ ...patch, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
64:       .eq('id', id);
65:     if (blendErr) throw blendErr;
66: 
67:     // replace all components
68:     const { error: delErr } = await supabase
69:       .from('blend_components')
70:       .delete()
71:       .eq('blend_id', id);
72:     if (delErr) throw delErr;
73: 
74:     const { error: compErr } = await supabase
75:       .from('blend_components')
76:       .insert(components.map((c) => ({ ...c, blend_id: id })));
77:     if (compErr) throw compErr;
78: 
79:     return blendApi.get(id);
80:   },
81: 
82:   delete: async (id: string): Promise<void> => {
83:     const { error } = await supabase.from('blends').delete().eq('id', id);
84:     if (error) throw error;
85:   },
86: };
</file>

<file path="src/features/active-roast/lib/phases.ts">
 1: import { parseTimeSec } from './time';
 2: import type { LogEntry } from '@shared/types/roast';
 3: 
 4: export interface PhaseSegment {
 5:     name: string;
 6:     startSec: number;
 7:     endSec: number;
 8:     durationSec: number;
 9:     pct: number;
10:     color: string;
11: }
12: 
13: const PHASE_FILL_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
14:     Drying: 'rgba(234,179,8,0.22)',
15:     Maillard: 'rgba(132,204,22,0.22)',
16:     Development: 'rgba(249,115,22,0.22)',
17: };
18: 
19: /**
20:  * logEntries + elapsed로 현재까지의 위상 구간 배열을 반환한다.
21:  * charged(Charge 이후)가 아니면 빈 배열.
22:  */
23: export const computePhaseSegments = (
24:     logEntries: LogEntry[],
25:     elapsed: number,
26:     charged: boolean,
27: ): PhaseSegment[] => {
28:     if (!charged || elapsed === 0) return [];
29: 
30:     const get = (event: string) => {
31:         const e = logEntries.find((l) => l.event === event);
32:         return e ? parseTimeSec(e.time) : null;
33:     };
34: 
35:     const yellow = get('Yellow');
36:     const fcStart = get('FC Start');
37:     const dropTime = get('Drop') ?? get('End') ?? elapsed;
38: 
39:     const bounds: { name: string; start: number | null; end: number }[] = [
40:         { name: 'Drying', start: 0, end: yellow ?? fcStart ?? dropTime },
41:         { name: 'Maillard', start: yellow, end: fcStart ?? dropTime },
42:         { name: 'Development', start: fcStart, end: dropTime },
43:     ];
44: 
45:     return bounds
46:         .filter((b): b is { name: string; start: number; end: number } => b.start != null && b.end > b.start)
47:         .map((b) => {
48:             const end = Math.min(b.end, elapsed);
49:             const dur = end - b.start;
50:             return {
51:                 name: b.name,
52:                 startSec: b.start,
53:                 endSec: end,
54:                 durationSec: dur,
55:                 pct: Math.round((dur / elapsed) * 100),
56:                 color: PHASE_FILL_COLORS[b.name],
57:             };
58:         });
59: };
</file>

<file path="src/features/active-roast/model/status.ts">
  1: import { create } from 'zustand';
  2: 
  3: export type RoastPhase = 'idle' | 'preheating' | 'standby' | 'roasting' | 'ended';
  4: 
  5: type LiveData = {
  6:     bt: number | null;
  7:     et: number | null;
  8:     ror: number;
  9:     ror_et: number;
 10:     heater: number;
 11:     fan: number;
 12:     drum: number;
 13: };
 14: 
 15: export interface RoastingState {
 16:     phase: RoastPhase;
 17:     elapsed: number;
 18:     sidecarConnected: boolean;
 19:     sidecarError: string | null;
 20:     machineCapabilities: string[];
 21:     liveData: LiveData | null;
 22:     pendingBeanId: string | null;
 23:     sessionId: string | null;
 24: 
 25:     // derived convenience
 26:     isRoasting: boolean;
 27:     charged: boolean;
 28: 
 29:     enterPreheating: (capabilities?: string[]) => void;
 30:     enterStandby: () => void;
 31:     startCharge: () => void;
 32:     endRoast: () => void;
 33:     tick: () => void;
 34:     setConnected: (connected: boolean, capabilities?: string[]) => void;
 35:     setError: (error: string | null) => void;
 36:     updateLiveData: (data: LiveData) => void;
 37:     setPendingBean: (beanId: string | null) => void;
 38:     reset: () => void;
 39: }
 40: 
 41: const initialState = {
 42:     phase: 'idle' as RoastPhase,
 43:     elapsed: 0,
 44:     sidecarConnected: false,
 45:     sidecarError: null as string | null,
 46:     machineCapabilities: [] as string[],
 47:     liveData: null as LiveData | null,
 48:     pendingBeanId: null as string | null,
 49:     sessionId: null as string | null,
 50:     isRoasting: false,
 51:     charged: false,
 52: };
 53: 
 54: export const useRoastingStore = create<RoastingState>((set, get) => ({
 55:     ...initialState,
 56: 
 57:     enterPreheating: (capabilities?: string[]) => {
 58:         set({
 59:             phase: 'preheating',
 60:             sidecarConnected: true,
 61:             ...(capabilities && { machineCapabilities: capabilities }),
 62:         });
 63:     },
 64: 
 65:     enterStandby: () => {
 66:         const { phase } = get();
 67:         if (phase !== 'preheating') return;
 68:         set({ phase: 'standby' });
 69:     },
 70: 
 71:     startCharge: () => {
 72:         set({ phase: 'roasting', charged: true, isRoasting: true, sessionId: crypto.randomUUID() });
 73:     },
 74: 
 75:     endRoast: () => {
 76:         set({ phase: 'ended', isRoasting: false });
 77:     },
 78: 
 79:     tick: () => {
 80:         set((state) => (state.isRoasting ? { elapsed: state.elapsed + 1 } : state));
 81:     },
 82: 
 83:     setConnected: (connected: boolean, capabilities?: string[]) => {
 84:         set({
 85:             sidecarConnected: connected,
 86:             ...(connected && { sidecarError: null }),
 87:             ...(capabilities && { machineCapabilities: capabilities }),
 88:             ...(!connected && { phase: get().phase === 'idle' ? 'idle' : get().phase }),
 89:         });
 90:     },
 91: 
 92:     setError: (error) => set({ sidecarError: error }),
 93: 
 94:     setPendingBean: (beanId) => {
 95:         set({ pendingBeanId: beanId });
 96:     },
 97: 
 98:     updateLiveData: (data) => {
 99:         const current = get().liveData;
100:         if (
101:             current &&
102:             current.bt === data.bt &&
103:             current.et === data.et &&
104:             current.ror === data.ror &&
105:             current.ror_et === data.ror_et &&
106:             current.heater === data.heater &&
107:             current.fan === data.fan &&
108:             current.drum === data.drum
109:         )
110:             return;
111:         set({ liveData: data });
112:     },
113: 
114:     reset: () => {
115:         const { sidecarConnected, machineCapabilities } = get();
116:         set({ ...initialState, sidecarConnected, machineCapabilities });
117:     },
118: }));

22: 
23:     const markEvent = useCallback(
24:         (event: string, note: string, buttonLabel?: string) => {
25:             const isRemoval = TOGGLEABLE_LOG_EVENTS.has(event) && logEntries.some((e) => e.event === event);
26: 
27:             setLogEntries((prev) => {
28:                 if (TOGGLEABLE_LOG_EVENTS.has(event) && prev.some((e) => e.event === event)) {
29:                     return prev.filter((e) => e.event !== event);
30:                 }
31: 
32:                 const newEntry: LogEntry = {
33:                     id: crypto.randomUUID(),
34:                     time: timeStr,
35:                     event,
36:                     temp: rawBT !== null ? formatTemp(rawBT, unit) : '',
37:                     note,
38:                 };
39: 
40:                 return [...prev, newEntry].sort((a, b) => parseTimeSec(a.time) - parseTimeSec(b.time));
41:             });
42: 
43:             if (!isRemoval && buttonLabel) {
44:                 flashButton(buttonLabel);
45:             }
46:         },
47:         [logEntries, timeStr, rawBT, unit, flashButton],
48:     );
49: 
50:     const handleDrop = useCallback(() => {
51:         markEvent('Drop', 'Coffee dropped', 'Drop');
52:     }, [markEvent]);
53: 
54:     const removeLogEntry = useCallback((id: string) => {
55:         setLogEntries((prev) => prev.filter((entry) => entry.id !== id));
56:     }, []);
57: 
58:     return {
59:         logEntries,
60:         pressedButtons,
61:         markEvent,
62:         flashButton,
63:         handleDrop,
64:         setLogEntries, // reset할 때 필요
65:         removeLogEntry,
66:     };
67: };
</file>

<file path="src/features/export-csv/lib/csv-export.ts">
 1: import type { RoastSessionWithRelations } from '@shared/types/database.types';
 2: 
 3: /** Escape a CSV field — wrap in quotes if it contains comma, quote, or newline. */
 4: const escapeField = (val: string): string => {
 5:     if (val.includes(',') || val.includes('"') || val.includes('\n') || val.includes('\r')) {
 6:         return `"${val.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
 7:     }
 8:     return val;
 9: };
10: 
11: /** Format duration in mm:ss for CSV (empty string for null, not em-dash). */
12: const formatDuration = (seconds: number | null): string => {
13:     if (seconds == null) return '';
14:     const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
15:     const s = seconds % 60;
16:     return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
17: };
18: 
19: export interface CsvRow {
20:     date: string;
21:     bean: string;
22:     origin: string;
23:     profile: string;
24:     weightGrams: number;
25:     inputKg: number;
26:     outputKg: number;
27:     lossRate: number;
28:     roastLevel: string;
29:     dropTemp: string;
30:     duration: string;
31:     notes: string;
32: }
33: 
34: const HEADERS: (keyof CsvRow)[] = [
35:     'date',
36:     'bean',
37:     'origin',
38:     'profile',
39:     'weightGrams',
40:     'inputKg',
41:     'outputKg',
42:     'lossRate',
43:     'roastLevel',
44:     'dropTemp',
45:     'duration',
46:     'notes',
47: ];
48: 
49: const HEADER_LABELS: Record<keyof CsvRow, string> = {
50:     date: 'Date',
51:     bean: 'Bean',
52:     origin: 'Origin',
53:     profile: 'Profile',
54:     weightGrams: 'Weight (g)',
55:     inputKg: 'Input (kg)',
56:     outputKg: 'Output (kg)',
57:     lossRate: 'Loss Rate (%)',
58:     roastLevel: 'Roast Level',
59:     dropTemp: 'Drop Temp (°C)',
60:     duration: 'Duration',
61:     notes: 'Notes',
62: };
63: 
64: const toCsvRow = (s: RoastSessionWithRelations): CsvRow => {
65:     const outputKg = (s.weight_grams ?? 0) / 1000;
66:     const inputKg = outputKg / 0.82;
67:     const lossRate = inputKg > 0 ? ((inputKg - outputKg) / inputKg) * 100 : 0;
68: 
69:     return {
70:         date: s.roasted_at ? s.roasted_at.slice(0, 10) : '',
71:         bean: s.beans?.name ?? '',
72:         origin: s.beans?.origin ?? '',
73:         profile: s.roast_profiles?.name ?? '',
74:         weightGrams: s.weight_grams ?? 0,
75:         inputKg: Math.round(inputKg * 1000) / 1000,
76:         outputKg: Math.round(outputKg * 1000) / 1000,
77:         lossRate: Math.round(lossRate * 10) / 10,
78:         roastLevel: s.roast_level ?? '',
79:         dropTemp: s.drop_temp_celsius != null ? `${s.drop_temp_celsius}°C` : '',
80:         duration: formatDuration(s.duration_seconds),
81:         notes: s.notes ?? '',
82:     };
83: };
84: 
85: /** Convert an array of RoastSessionWithRelations to a CSV string with BOM. */
86: export const sessionsToCsv = (sessions: RoastSessionWithRelations[]): string => {
87:     const header = HEADERS.map((h) => HEADER_LABELS[h]).join(',') + '\n';
88: 
89:     const rows = sessions
90:         .map((s) => {
91:             const row = toCsvRow(s);
92:             return HEADERS.map((h) => escapeField(String(row[h]))).join(',');
93:         })
94:         .join('\n');
95: 
96:     return `\uFEFF${header}${rows}\n`;
97: };
</file>

<file path="src/features/updater/lib/useUpdateChecker.ts">
  1: import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
  2: import { check } from '@tauri-apps/plugin-updater';
  3: import { relaunch } from '@tauri-apps/plugin-process';
  4: import { sendNotification, isPermissionGranted, requestPermission } from '@tauri-apps/plugin-notification';
  5: import type { DownloadEvent } from '@tauri-apps/plugin-updater';
  6: 
  7: export type UpdateStatus = 'idle' | 'checking' | 'downloading' | 'ready' | 'error';
  8: 
  9: export interface UpdateState {
 10:   status: UpdateStatus;
 11:   /** 새 버전 식별자 (e.g. "1.0.5") */
 12:   version: string | null;
 13:   /** 다운로드 진행률 0–100 */
 14:   progress: number;
 15:   /** 에러 메시지 */
 16:   error: string | null;
 17: }
 18: 
 19: export interface UseUpdateCheckerReturn {
 20:   state: UpdateState;
 21:   /** 조용히 체크 → 다운로드 시작. DEV 모드면 아무 일도 안 함. */
 22:   checkAndDownload: () => Promise<void>;
 23:   /** 앱 재시작 (업데이트 적용) */
 24:   applyAndRelaunch: () => Promise<void>;
 25: }
 26: 
 27: const INITIAL_STATE: UpdateState = {
 28:   status: 'idle',
 29:   version: null,
 30:   progress: 0,
 31:   error: null,
 32: };
 33: 
 34: /** 시스템 알림 권한 확보 (앱 생애 첫 한 번만 묻고 이후 재사용) */
 35: let permissionReady: Promise<boolean> | null = null;
 36: const ensurePermission = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
 37:   if (permissionReady) return permissionReady;
 38:   permissionReady = (async () => {
 39:     if (await isPermissionGranted()) return true;
 40:     const result = await requestPermission();
 41:     return result === 'granted';
 42:   })();
 43:   return permissionReady;
 44: };
 45: 
 46: export const useUpdateChecker = (): UseUpdateCheckerReturn => {
 47:   const [state, setState] = useState<UpdateState>(INITIAL_STATE);
 48:   const downloadedRef = useRef(0);
 49:   const totalRef = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined);
 50: 
 51:   const checkAndDownload = useCallback(async () => {
 52:     if (import.meta.env.DEV) return;
 53: 
 54:     setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, status: 'checking', error: null }));
 55: 
 56:     try {
 57:       const update = await check();
 58:       if (!update) {
 59:         setState(INITIAL_STATE);
 60:         return;
 61:       }
 62: 
 63:       // 새 버전 발견 — 백그라운드 다운로드 시작
 64:       downloadedRef.current = 0;
 65:       totalRef.current = undefined;
 66:       setState({ status: 'downloading', version: update.version, progress: 0, error: null });
 67: 
 68:       await update.downloadAndInstall((event: DownloadEvent) => {
 69:         if (event.event === 'Started') {
 70:           totalRef.current = event.data.contentLength;
 71:         } else if (event.event === 'Progress') {
 72:           downloadedRef.current += event.data.chunkLength;
 73:           const total = totalRef.current;
 74:           const pct =
 75:             total && total > 0
 76:               ? Math.round((downloadedRef.current / total) * 100)
 77:               : Math.min(downloadedRef.current / 1024 / 50, 95);
 78:           setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, progress: Math.min(pct, 99) }));
 79:         }
 80:       });
 81: 
 82:       setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, status: 'ready', progress: 100 }));
 83: 
 84:       // 시스템 알림 발송 (권한 확인 후)
 85:       ensurePermission().then((granted) => {
 86:         if (granted) {
 87:           sendNotification({
 88:             title: 'First Crack 업데이트 준비 완료',
 89:             body: `v${update.version} — 앱을 재시작하면 적용됩니다.`,
 90:           });
 91:         }
 92:       });
 93:     } catch (error) {
 94:       const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : '업데이트 확인 중 오류가 발생했습니다.';
 95:       console.error('[updater]', msg, error);
 96:       setState({ status: 'error', version: null, progress: 0, error: msg });
 97:     }
 98:   }, []);
 99: 
100:   const applyAndRelaunch = useCallback(async () => {
101:     await relaunch();
102:   }, []);
103: 
104:   return { state, checkAndDownload, applyAndRelaunch };
105: };
</file>

 85: /** BT 커브를 30초 간격으로 생성. dropTemp와 총 duration(초)를 기반으로 계산. */
 86: export const generateProfileCurve = (dropTemp: number, duration: number): { t: number; bt: number }[] => {
 87:     const points: { t: number; bt: number }[] = [];
 88:     for (let t = 0; t <= duration; t += 30) {
 89:         let bt: number;
 90:         if (t <= 90) {
 91:             bt = 200 - (48 * t) / 90;
 92:         } else {
 93:             const remaining = duration - 90;
 94:             const rise = dropTemp - 152;
 95:             const elapsed = t - 90;
 96:             bt = 152 + rise * Math.pow(elapsed / remaining, 0.75);
 97:         }
 98:         points.push({ t, bt: Math.round(bt * 10) / 10 });
 99:     }
100:     return points;
101: };
102: 
103: /** 시간(초)에 대한 BT를 선형 보간으로 반환 */
104: export const interpolateProfileBT = (
105:     curve: { t: number; bt: number }[],
106:     timeSec: number,
107: ): number | null => {
108:     if (curve.length === 0) return null;
109:     if (timeSec <= curve[0].t) return curve[0].bt;
110:     if (timeSec >= curve[curve.length - 1].t) return curve[curve.length - 1].bt;
111:     for (let i = 0; i < curve.length - 1; i++) {
112:         const lo = curve[i];
113:         const hi = curve[i + 1];
114:         if (lo.t <= timeSec && timeSec <= hi.t) {
115:             const ratio = (timeSec - lo.t) / (hi.t - lo.t);
116:             return lo.bt + ratio * (hi.bt - lo.bt);
117:         }
118:     }
119:     return null;
120: };

<file path="src/shared/lib/download.ts">
 1: /** Trigger a browser download of a Blob. Works in both Tauri and web. */
 2: export const downloadBlob = (filename: string, blob: Blob): void => {
 3:     const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
 4: 
 5:     const a = document.createElement('a');
 6:     a.href = url;
 7:     a.download = filename;
 8:     a.style.display = 'none';
 9:     document.body.appendChild(a);
10:     a.click();
11: 
12:     setTimeout(() => {
13:         document.body.removeChild(a);
14:         URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
15:     }, 100);
16: };
17: 
18: /** Trigger a browser download of a CSV string. */
19: export const downloadCsv = (filename: string, csv: string): void => {
20:     const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
21:     downloadBlob(filename, blob);
22: };
</file>

 1: /**

11:     if (import.meta.env.DEV) console.warn(...args);
12:   },
13:   log: (...args: unknown[]) => {
14:     if (import.meta.env.DEV) console.log(...args);

<file path="src/shared/lib/r2.ts">
 1: import { S3Client, GetObjectCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
 2: 
 3: // TODO: VITE_R2_* 자격증명이 client 번들에 노출됨.
 4: // 후속 PR에서 Cloudflare Worker + Supabase JWT 검증 + presigned URL로 이전 예정.
 5: // 영향: roast TSV upload/read 전체.
 6: 
 7: let client: S3Client | null = null;
 8: 
 9: const getClient = (): S3Client => {
10:     if (client) return client;
11:     client = new S3Client({
12:         region: 'auto',
13:         endpoint: `https://${import.meta.env.VITE_R2_ACCOUNT_ID}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
14:         credentials: {
15:             accessKeyId: import.meta.env.VITE_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID,
16:             secretAccessKey: import.meta.env.VITE_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY,
17:         },
18:     });
19:     return client;
20: };
21: 
22: export const fetchTsvFromR2 = async (key: string): Promise<string> => {
23:     const res = await getClient().send(
24:         new GetObjectCommand({
25:             Bucket: import.meta.env.VITE_R2_BUCKET_NAME,
26:             Key: key,
27:         }),
28:     );
29:     if (!res.Body) throw new Error(`Empty body for R2 key: ${key}`);
30:     return await res.Body.transformToString();
31: };
</file>

<file path="src/shared/lib/tsv.ts">
 1: export interface TsvPoint {
 2:     t: number;
 3:     bt: number;
 4:     et: number | null;
 5:     ror: number | null;
 6: }
 7: 
 8: // TSV 형식 (useSidecarPolling.ts:21):
 9: // time\tbt\tet\tror\theater\tfan\tdrum
10: // t는 charge 시점(=0) 기준 post-charge 상대 시간(초).
11: export const parseTsv = (text: string): TsvPoint[] => {
12:     const lines = text.split('\n');
13:     const points: TsvPoint[] = [];
14:     for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
15:         const line = lines[i];
16:         if (!line) continue;
17:         const cols = line.split('\t');
18:         if (cols.length < 2) continue;
19:         const t = parseFloat(cols[0]);
20:         const bt = parseFloat(cols[1]);
21:         if (!Number.isFinite(t) || !Number.isFinite(bt)) continue;
22:         const et = cols[2] ? parseFloat(cols[2]) : NaN;
23:         const ror = cols[3] ? parseFloat(cols[3]) : NaN;
24:         points.push({
25:             t,
26:             bt,
27:             et: Number.isFinite(et) ? et : null,
28:             ror: Number.isFinite(ror) ? ror : null,
29:         });
30:     }
31:     return points;
32: };
</file>

<file path="src/shared/lib/useFormEscape.ts">
 1: import { useEffect } from 'react';
 2: 
 3: /**
 4:  * 전역 Escape 키를 감지해 onClose를 호출한다.
 5:  * 모달이 열려 있을 때만 리스너를 등록하며, contentEditable/form 요소에서는 무시한다.
 6:  */
 7: export const useFormEscape = (open: boolean, onClose: () => void) => {
 8:     useEffect(() => {
 9:         if (!open) return;
10:         const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
11:             if (e.key === 'Escape') {
12:                 onClose();
13:             }
14:         };
15:         window.addEventListener('keydown', handler);
16:         return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handler);
17:     }, [open, onClose]);
18: };
</file>

<file path="src/shared/store/theme.ts">
 1: import { create } from 'zustand';
 2: 
 3: export type Theme = 'light' | 'dark' | 'system';
 4: 
 5: const STORAGE_KEY = 'fc_theme';
 6: 
 7: function getInitialResolved(theme: Theme | null): 'light' | 'dark' {
 8:     if (theme === 'dark') return 'dark';
 9:     if (theme === 'light') return 'light';
10:     return matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
11: }
12: 
13: function applyThemeToDOM(resolved: 'light' | 'dark') {
14:     document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', resolved === 'dark');
15: }
16: 
17: interface ThemeState {
18:     theme: Theme | null; // null = 아직 선택 안 함 (온보딩 모달 표시)
19:     resolvedTheme: 'light' | 'dark';
20:     setTheme: (theme: Theme) => void;
21:     initTheme: () => void;
22: }
23: 
24: let mediaQuery: MediaQueryList | null = null;
25: let mediaListener: ((e: MediaQueryListEvent) => void) | null = null;
26: 
27: export const useThemeStore = create<ThemeState>((set) => ({
28:     theme: null,
29:     resolvedTheme: 'light',
30: 
31:     initTheme: () => {
32:         const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) as Theme | null;
33:         const resolved = getInitialResolved(stored);
34:         applyThemeToDOM(resolved);
35:         set({ theme: stored, resolvedTheme: resolved });
36: 
37:         // system 테마 변경 리스너
38:         if (stored === 'system' || stored === null) {
39:             mediaQuery = matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
40:             mediaListener = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => {
41:                 const next = e.matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
42:                 applyThemeToDOM(next);
43:                 set({ resolvedTheme: next });
44:             };
45:             mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', mediaListener);
46:         }
47:     },
48: 
49:     setTheme: (theme: Theme) => {
50:         // 이전 mediaQuery 리스너 제거
51:         if (mediaQuery && mediaListener) {
52:             mediaQuery.removeEventListener('change', mediaListener);
53:             mediaQuery = null;
54:             mediaListener = null;
55:         }
56: 
57:         const resolved = getInitialResolved(theme);
58:         applyThemeToDOM(resolved);
59:         localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, theme);
60:         set({ theme, resolvedTheme: resolved });
61: 
62:         // system 리스너 재등록
63:         if (theme === 'system') {
64:             mediaQuery = matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
65:             mediaListener = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => {
66:                 const next = e.matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
67:                 applyThemeToDOM(next);
68:                 set({ resolvedTheme: next });
69:             };
70:             mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', mediaListener);
71:         }
72:     },
73: }));
