<file path="src/shared/ui/MonthlyBatchesChart.tsx">
  1: import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
  2: 
  3: interface MonthlyBatchesChartProps {
  4:     data: { month: string; batches: number }[];
  5: }
  6: 
  7: export const MonthlyBatchesChart = ({ data }: MonthlyBatchesChartProps) => {
  8:     const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  9:     const tooltipRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
 10:     const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
 11: 
 12:     const draw = (canvas: HTMLCanvasElement) => {
 13:         const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
 14:         const W = canvas.offsetWidth;
 15:         const H = canvas.offsetHeight;
 16:         if (!W || !H) return;
 17:         canvas.width = W * dpr;
 18:         canvas.height = H * dpr;
 19:         canvas.style.width = `${W}px`;
 20:         canvas.style.height = `${H}px`;
 21: 
 22:         const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')!;
 23:         ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
 24: 
 25:         const cs = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
 26:         const colorPrimary = cs.getPropertyValue('--color-primary').trim() || '#171717';
 27:         const colorMuted = cs.getPropertyValue('--color-muted').trim() || '#9ca3af';
 28: 
 29:         const maxVal = Math.max(...data.map((d) => d.batches), 1);
 30:         const padSide = 18;
 31:         const padT = 8;
 32:         const padB = 28;
 33:         const plotW = W - padSide * 2;
 34:         const plotH = H - padT - padB;
 35:         const barW = Math.min(20, (plotW / data.length) * 0.5);
 36:         const gap = plotW / data.length;
 37: 
 38:         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)';
 39:         ctx.lineWidth = 1;
 40:         for (let i = 0; i <= 3; i++) {
 41:             const y = padT + plotH - (i / 3) * plotH;
 42:             ctx.beginPath();
 43:             ctx.moveTo(padSide, y);
 44:             ctx.lineTo(padSide + plotW, y);
 45:             ctx.stroke();
 46:             ctx.fillStyle = colorMuted;
 47:             ctx.font = '11px sans-serif';
 48:             ctx.textAlign = 'right';
 49:             ctx.fillText(String(Math.round((i / 3) * maxVal)), padSide - 4, y + 4);
 50:         }
 51: 
 52:         data.forEach((d, i) => {
 53:             const x = padSide + gap * i + gap / 2 - barW / 2;
 54:             const barH = (d.batches / maxVal) * plotH;
 55:             const y = padT + plotH - barH;
 56:             const r = 4;
 57: 
 58:             ctx.fillStyle = colorPrimary;
 59:             ctx.beginPath();
 60:             ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
 61:             ctx.lineTo(x + barW - r, y);
 62:             ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + barW, y, x + barW, y + r);
 63:             ctx.lineTo(x + barW, y + barH);
 64:             ctx.lineTo(x, y + barH);
 65:             ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
 66:             ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
 67:             ctx.closePath();
 68:             ctx.fill();
 69: 
 70:             ctx.fillStyle = colorMuted;
 71:             ctx.font = '12px sans-serif';
 72:             ctx.textAlign = 'center';
 73:             ctx.fillText(d.month, padSide + gap * i + gap / 2, H - 6);
 74:         });
 75:     };
 76: 
 77:     useEffect(() => {
 78:         const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 79:         if (!canvas) return;
 80:         draw(canvas);
 81:         const obs = new ResizeObserver(() => {
 82:             if (canvas) draw(canvas);
 83:         });
 84:         obs.observe(canvas.parentElement!);
 85:         return () => obs.disconnect();
 86:         // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
 87:     }, [data]);
 88: 
 89:     const handleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
 90:         const canvas = canvasRef.current;
 91:         const tt = tooltipRef.current;
 92:         if (!canvas || !tt) return;
 93: 
 94:         const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 95:         const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
 96:         const W = canvas.offsetWidth;
 97:         const padSide = 18;
 98:         const plotW = W - padSide * 2;
 99:         const gap = plotW / data.length;
100: 
101:         const idx = Math.floor((mx - padSide) / gap);
102:         if (idx < 0 || idx >= data.length) {
103:             tt.style.display = 'none';
104:             return;
105:         }
106: 
107:         tt.textContent = `${data[idx].month}: ${data[idx].batches} batches`;
108:         tt.style.display = 'block';
109:         tt.style.left = `${e.clientX - rect.left + 10}px`;
110:         tt.style.top = `${e.clientY - rect.top - 30}px`;
111:     };
112: 
113:     return (
114:         <div ref={containerRef} className="relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center">
115:             <canvas
116:                 ref={canvasRef}
117:                 className="block w-full h-full"
118:                 onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
119:                 onMouseLeave={() => {
120:                     if (tooltipRef.current) tooltipRef.current.style.display = 'none';
121:                 }}
122:             />
123:             <div
124:                 ref={tooltipRef}
125:                 className="absolute pointer-events-none bg-white rounded-[10px] px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] whitespace-nowrap z-10"
126:                 style={{
127:                     display: 'none',
128:                     boxShadow: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4) 0px 0px 1px, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 0px 4px 4px',
129:                 }}
130:             />
131:         </div>
132:     );
133: };

<file path="src/views/active-roast/hooks/useChartData.ts">
 1: import { useMemo } from 'react';
 2: import { interpolateProfileBT } from '@shared/data/roast-profiles';
 3: import type { TsvPoint } from '@shared/lib/tsv';
 4: import type { LiveRoastPoint } from './useSidecarPolling';
 5: 
 6: /** 차트 전체 x축 범위(초). uPlot에 항상 이 길이를 보장한다. */
 7: export const CHART_TOTAL_SECS = 780;
 8: 
 9: export const useChartData = ({
10:     livePoints,
11:     targetCurvePoints,
12:     preChargeDisplaySec,
13: }: {
14:     livePoints: LiveRoastPoint[];
15:     /** 타깃 프로파일의 실제 저장 데이터. 없으면 빈 배열. */
16:     targetCurvePoints: TsvPoint[];
17:     preChargeDisplaySec: number;
18: }) => {
19:     const targetSamples = useMemo(
20:         () =>
21:             targetCurvePoints.map((p) => ({
22:                 time: p.t,
23:                 btActual: null as number | null,
24:                 etActual: null as number | null,
25:                 rorActual: null as number | null,
26:                 etRorActual: null as number | null,
27:                 btTarget: p.bt,
28:             })),
29:         [targetCurvePoints],
30:     );
31: 
32:     const chartData = useMemo(() => {
33:         const hasTarget = targetCurvePoints.length > 0;
34:         const sentinel = (t: number) => ({
35:             time: t,
36:             btActual: null as number | null,
37:             etActual: null as number | null,
38:             rorActual: null as number | null,
39:             etRorActual: null as number | null,
40:             btTarget: hasTarget ? interpolateProfileBT(targetCurvePoints, t) : null,
41:         });
42: 
43:         const live = livePoints.map((p) => ({
44:             time: p.time,
45:             btActual: p.bt,
46:             etActual: p.et,
47:             rorActual: p.ror,
48:             etRorActual: p.ror_et,
49:             btTarget: hasTarget ? interpolateProfileBT(targetCurvePoints, p.time) : null,
50:         }));
51: 
52:         const seen = new Set<number>();
53:         const deduped: ReturnType<typeof sentinel>[] = [];
54:         for (const p of live) {
55:             const key = Math.round(p.time * 100);
56:             if (!seen.has(key)) {
57:                 seen.add(key);
58:                 deduped.push(p);
59:             }
60:         }
61:         for (const p of targetSamples) {
62:             const key = Math.round(p.time * 100);
63:             if (!seen.has(key)) {
64:                 seen.add(key);
65:                 deduped.push(p);
66:             }
67:         }
68:         deduped.sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time);
69: 
70:         const xMin = -preChargeDisplaySec;
71:         const needsStart = deduped.length === 0 || deduped[0].time > xMin + 0.5;
72:         const needsEnd = deduped.length === 0 || deduped[deduped.length - 1].time < CHART_TOTAL_SECS - 1;
73:         return [
74:             ...(needsStart ? [sentinel(xMin)] : []),
75:             ...deduped,
76:             ...(needsEnd ? [sentinel(CHART_TOTAL_SECS)] : []),
77:         ];
78:     }, [livePoints, targetCurvePoints, targetSamples, preChargeDisplaySec]);
79: 
80:     return { chartData };
81: };
</file>

<file path="src/views/dashboard/useDashboard.ts">
  1: import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
  2: import { supabase } from '@shared/lib/supabase'
  3: import type { Bean, RoastSessionWithRelations } from '@shared/types/database.types'
  4: 
  5: export interface MonthlyBatch {
  6:     month: string
  7:     batches: number
  8: }
  9: 
 10: export interface UpcomingBatch {
 11:     id: string
 12:     bean_name: string
 13:     batch_count: number
 14:     target_roasted_kg: number
 15:     status: string
 16:     date: string
 17: }
 18: 
 19: export interface DashboardData {
 20:     batchesThisMonth: number
 21:     batchesLastMonth: number
 22:     kgRoastedThisMonth: number
 23:     kgRoastedLastMonth: number
 24:     avgDurationSeconds: number
 25:     avgDurationLastMonthSeconds: number
 26:     recentSessions: RoastSessionWithRelations[]
 27:     upcomingBatches: UpcomingBatch[]
 28:     inventoryAlerts: Bean[]
 29:     monthlyBatches: MonthlyBatch[]
 30:     loading: boolean
 31:     error: string | null
 32: }
 33: 
 34: const MONTH_LABELS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']
 35: 
 36: const fetchDashboard = async (userId: string): Promise<Omit<DashboardData, 'loading' | 'error'>> => {
 37:     const now = new Date()
 38:     const today = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
 39:     const thisMonthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1).toISOString()
 40:     const lastMonthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - 1, 1).toISOString()
 41:     const sixMonthsAgo = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - 5, 1).toISOString()
 42: 
 43:     const [completedRes, upcomingPlansRes, alertsRes, monthlyRes] = await Promise.all([
 44:         supabase
 45:             .from('roast_sessions')
 46:             .select('*, beans(name, origin), roast_profiles!profile_id(name, target_level)')
 47:             .eq('user_id', userId)
 48:             .eq('status', 'completed')
 49:             .gte('roasted_at', lastMonthStart)
 50:             .order('roasted_at', { ascending: false }),
 51: 
 52:         supabase
 53:             .from('roast_day_plans')
 54:             .select('id, date')
 55:             .eq('user_id', userId)
 56:             .gte('date', today)
 57:             .order('date')
 58:             .limit(14),
 59: 
 60:         // 전체 가져와서 클라이언트에서 필터 (PostgREST는 컬럼 간 비교 미지원)
 61:         supabase
 62:             .from('beans')
 63:             .select('*')
 64:             .eq('user_id', userId),
 65: 
 66:         supabase
 67:             .from('roast_sessions')
 68:             .select('roasted_at, weight_grams')
 69:             .eq('user_id', userId)
 70:             .eq('status', 'completed')
 71:             .gte('roasted_at', sixMonthsAgo)
 72:             .order('roasted_at', { ascending: true }),
 73:     ])
 74: 
 75:     if (completedRes.error) throw completedRes.error
 76:     if (upcomingPlansRes.error) throw upcomingPlansRes.error
 77:     if (alertsRes.error) throw alertsRes.error
 78:     if (monthlyRes.error) throw monthlyRes.error
 79: 
 80:     let upcomingBatches: UpcomingBatch[] = []
 81:     if (upcomingPlansRes.data && upcomingPlansRes.data.length > 0) {
 82:         const planIds = upcomingPlansRes.data.map((p) => p.id)
 83:         const planDateMap = new Map(upcomingPlansRes.data.map((p) => [p.id, p.date]))
 84:         const { data: batchData } = await supabase
 85:             .from('roast_plan_batches')
 86:             .select('id, plan_id, bean_name, batch_count, target_roasted_kg, status, order_index')
 87:             .in('plan_id', planIds)
 88:             .in('status', ['pending', 'in-progress'])
 89:             .order('order_index')
 90:             .limit(5)
 91:         upcomingBatches = (batchData ?? [])
 92:             .map((b) => ({
 93:                 id: b.id,
 94:                 bean_name: b.bean_name,
 95:                 batch_count: b.batch_count,
 96:                 target_roasted_kg: b.target_roasted_kg,
 97:                 status: b.status,
 98:                 date: planDateMap.get(b.plan_id) ?? today,
 99:                 order_index: b.order_index,
100:             }))
101:             .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || a.order_index - b.order_index)
102:             // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars
103:             .map(({ order_index: _, ...rest }) => rest)
104:     }
105: 
106:     const completed = completedRes.data as RoastSessionWithRelations[]
107:     const thisMonth = completed.filter((s) => s.roasted_at! >= thisMonthStart)
108:     const lastMonth = completed.filter((s) => s.roasted_at! < thisMonthStart)
109: 
110:     const sumKg = (arr: typeof completed) =>
111:         arr.reduce((acc, s) => acc + s.weight_grams, 0) / 1000
112:     const avgDuration = (arr: typeof completed) =>
113:         arr.length > 0
114:             ? arr.reduce((acc, s) => acc + (s.duration_seconds ?? 0), 0) / arr.length
115:             : 0
116: 
117:     const monthlyMap = new Map<string, number>()
118:     for (let i = 5; i >= 0; i--) {
119:         const d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - i, 1)
120:         monthlyMap.set(`${d.getFullYear()}-${d.getMonth()}`, 0)
121:     }
122:     for (const s of (monthlyRes.data ?? []) as { roasted_at: string | null }[]) {
123:         const d = new Date(s.roasted_at!)
124:         const key = `${d.getFullYear()}-${d.getMonth()}`
125:         if (monthlyMap.has(key)) {
126:             monthlyMap.set(key, (monthlyMap.get(key) ?? 0) + 1)
127:         }
128:     }
129:     const monthlyBatches: MonthlyBatch[] = Array.from(monthlyMap.entries()).map(([key, batches]) => {
130:         const [year, month] = key.split('-').map(Number)
131:         return { month: MONTH_LABELS[month], batches, year, _month: month }
132:     }) as MonthlyBatch[]
133: 
134:     const allBeans = (alertsRes.data ?? []) as Bean[]
135:     const inventoryAlerts = allBeans.filter((b) => b.stock_grams <= b.low_stock_threshold_grams)
136: 
137:     return {
138:         batchesThisMonth: thisMonth.length,
139:         batchesLastMonth: lastMonth.length,
140:         kgRoastedThisMonth: sumKg(thisMonth),
141:         kgRoastedLastMonth: sumKg(lastMonth),
142:         avgDurationSeconds: avgDuration(thisMonth),
143:         avgDurationLastMonthSeconds: avgDuration(lastMonth),
144:         recentSessions: completed.slice(0, 5),
145:         upcomingBatches,
146:         inventoryAlerts,
147:         monthlyBatches,
148:     }
149: }
150: 
151: const EMPTY: Omit<DashboardData, 'loading' | 'error'> = {
152:     batchesThisMonth: 0,
153:     batchesLastMonth: 0,
154:     kgRoastedThisMonth: 0,
155:     kgRoastedLastMonth: 0,
156:     avgDurationSeconds: 0,
157:     avgDurationLastMonthSeconds: 0,
158:     recentSessions: [],
159:     upcomingBatches: [],
160:     inventoryAlerts: [],
161:     monthlyBatches: [],
162: }
163: 
164: export const useDashboard = (userId: string): DashboardData => {
165:     const { data, isLoading, error } = useQuery({
166:         queryKey: ['dashboard', userId],
167:         queryFn: () => fetchDashboard(userId),
168:         enabled: !!userId,
169:         // 5분 캐시 — 날짜 기반 집계 데이터라 Infinity 대신 짧게 설정
170:         staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
171:     })
172: 
173:     return {
174:         ...(data ?? EMPTY),
175:         loading: isLoading,
176:         error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : null,
177:     }
178: }

<file path="src/views/schedule/hooks/useScheduleNav.ts">
 1: import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
 2: import { addDays, addWeeks, addMonths, startOfWeek, endOfWeek, format } from 'date-fns';
 3: import { ko } from 'date-fns/locale';
 4: import { isToday } from 'date-fns';
 5: import type { ViewMode } from '../lib';

 7: 
 8: export const useScheduleNav = () => {
 9:     const [view, setView] = useState<ViewMode>('day');
10:     const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState(new Date());
11: 
12:     const handleSelectDay = useCallback((d: Date) => {
13:         setSelectedDate(d);
14:         setView('day');
15:     }, []);
16: 
17:     const handleNav = useCallback((dir: 1 | -1) => {
18:         setSelectedDate((prev) => {

20:             if (view === 'week') return addWeeks(prev, dir);
21:             return addMonths(prev, dir);

23:     }, [view]);
24: 
25:     const navLabel = (() => {

28:             const ws = startOfWeek(selectedDate, { weekStartsOn: 1 });
29:             const we = endOfWeek(selectedDate, { weekStartsOn: 1 });
30:             return `${format(ws, 'M/d')} – ${format(we, 'M/d')}`;
31:         }
32:         return format(selectedDate, 'yyyy년 M월', { locale: ko });
33:     })();
34: 
35:     const isTodaySelected = isToday(selectedDate);
36: 
37:     const goToday = useCallback(() => {
38:         setSelectedDate(new Date());
39:     }, []);
40: 
41:     return { view, setView, selectedDate, handleSelectDay, handleNav, navLabel, isTodaySelected, goToday };
42: };

<file path="src/views/schedule/lib.ts">
 1: import { format } from 'date-fns';
 2: import { ko } from 'date-fns/locale';
 3: import type { PlanBatchWithProgress } from '@shared/types/database.types';
 4: 
 5: export type ViewMode = 'day' | 'week' | 'month';
 6: 
 7: export const toDateKey = (d: Date): string => format(d, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
 8: 
 9: export const toFullDisplayDate = (d: Date): string =>
10:     format(d, 'yyyy년 M월 d일 (eee)', { locale: ko });
11: 
12: export const batchProgress = (b: PlanBatchWithProgress) =>
13:     `${b.completed_sessions}/${b.batch_count}`;
14: 
15: export type BatchStatus = 'pending' | 'in-progress' | 'done' | 'skipped';
16: 
17: export const batchStatus = (b: PlanBatchWithProgress): BatchStatus => {
18:     if (b.status === 'done' || b.status === 'skipped') return b.status;
19:     if (b.completed_sessions >= b.batch_count) return 'done';
20:     if (b.completed_sessions > 0) return 'in-progress';
21:     return 'pending';
22: };
23: 
24: /** Map RRule string to human-readable label */
25: export const getRecurrenceLabel = (rrule: string | null): string => {
26:     if (!rrule) return '';
27:     if (rrule.includes('FREQ=DAILY')) return '매일';
28:     if (rrule.includes('FREQ=WEEKLY')) {
29:         if (rrule.includes('INTERVAL=2')) return '격주';
30:         return '매주';
31:     }
32:     if (rrule.includes('FREQ=MONTHLY')) return '매월';
33:     return '반복';
34: };
</file>

<file path="src/views/schedule/MonthView.tsx">

 2: import { useMonthSummary } from '@entities/plan';
 3: import { toDateKey } from './lib';
 4: import { DayBatchPreview } from './DayBatchPreview';
 5: 
 6: export const MonthView = ({
 7:     selectedDate,

16:     const month = selectedDate.getMonth();

19: 
20:     const monthStart = startOfMonth(selectedDate);

22:     const gridStart = startOfWeek(monthStart, { weekStartsOn: 1 });
23:     const gridEnd = endOfWeek(monthEnd, { weekStartsOn: 1 });
24:     const days = eachDayOfInterval({ start: gridStart, end: gridEnd });
25:     const numWeeks = days.length / 7;
26: 
27:     const dayHeaders = ['월', '화', '수', '목', '금', '토', '일'];

36:                     >
37:                         {d}
38:                     </div>
39:                 ))}
40:             </div>
41: 
42:             <div
43:                 className="flex-1 grid grid-cols-7 overflow-hidden"

62:                                 flex flex-col gap-1 p-2 border-none cursor-pointer text-left

64:                                 ${isSelected ? 'bg-primary/5' : isCurrentMonth ? 'bg-main-bg hover:bg-surface' : 'bg-surface/40 hover:bg-surface'}
65:                                 ${!isLastRow ? 'border-b border-border-subtle dark:border-[#585d61]' : ''}
66:                                 ${!isLastCol ? 'border-r border-border-subtle dark:border-[#585d61]' : ''}
67:                             `}
68:                         >
69:                             <div className="flex justify-end">
70:                                 <span className={`
71:                                     text-[12px] font-medium w-6 h-6 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full leading-none
72:                                     ${today ? 'bg-primary text-white' : isCurrentMonth ? 'text-primary' : 'text-muted/40'}

75:                                 </span>
76:                             </div>

 51: }: {
 52:     items: readonly string[];
 53:     renderItem: (item: string) => React.ReactNode;

 61:             {visible.map(renderItem)}

 4:     name: z.string().min(1, '블렌드 이름을 입력하세요').max(100),
 5:     description: z.string().max(500),
 6:     components: z
 7:         .array(

 9:                 bean_id: z.string().min(1, '생두를 선택하세요'),

15:             message: '구성 비율 합계가 100%여야 합니다',
16:         }),
17: });

 17:     batchLabel: string;

<file path="src/main.tsx">
 1: import React from 'react';
 2: import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client';
 3: import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
 4: import * as Sentry from '@sentry/react';
 5: import { App } from './App';
 6: import { initI18n } from './shared/i18n';
 7: import 'uplot/dist/uPlot.min.css';
 8: 
 9: const is4xx = (error: unknown) => {
10:     if (!error || typeof error !== 'object') return false;
11:     const status =
12:         (error as Record<string, unknown>).status ?? (error as { response?: { status?: unknown } }).response?.status;
13:     return typeof status === 'number' && status >= 400 && status < 500;
14: };
15: 
16: const queryClient = new QueryClient({
17:     defaultOptions: {
18:         queries: {
19:             staleTime: Infinity,
20:             refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
21:             // 4xx는 재시도 의미 없음 (인증/권한 문제) — 서버 오류(5xx)만 최대 2회 재시도
22:             retry: (failureCount, error) => !is4xx(error) && failureCount < 2,
23:         },
24:     },
25: });
26: 
27: if (import.meta.env.PROD && import.meta.env.VITE_SENTRY_DSN) {
28:     Sentry.init({
29:         dsn: import.meta.env.VITE_SENTRY_DSN,
30:         environment: 'production',
31:         integrations: [Sentry.browserTracingIntegration()],
32:         tracesSampleRate: 0.1,
33:     });
34: }
35: 
36: const bootstrap = async () => {
37:     await initI18n();
38: 
39:     ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root') as HTMLElement).render(
40:         <React.StrictMode>
41:             <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>

<file path="src-tauri/sidecar/adapters/kaleido.py">
  1: import asyncio
  2: import time
  3: import logging
  4: from typing import Any
  5: 
  6: from adapters.base import Reading
  7: 
  8: _log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
  9: 
 10: # extern/kaleido.py KaleidoPort timeouts: open=6s, init=6s → 넉넉히 15s
 11: _CONNECT_TIMEOUT = 15.0
 12: _CONNECT_POLL = 0.1
 13: 
 14: 
 15: class KaleidoAdapter:
 16:     """
 17:     Kaleido 전용 드라이버 (extern/kaleido.py).
 18:     mode="TCP"    → WebSocket (Network.aset, port 80)
 19:     mode="Serial" → MODBUS RTU (Serial.aset, baudrate 57600)
 20: 
 21:     connect()은 extern/kaleido.py의 ws_initialize() (Ping→TU→SC) 완료를
 22:     sid + TU 상태 폴링으로 확인한 뒤 반환한다.
 23:     """
 24: 
 25:     def __init__(
 26:         self,
 27:         mode: str = "TCP",
 28:         host: str = "127.0.0.1",
 29:         port: int = 80,
 30:         path: str = "ws",
 31:         comport: str = "",
 32:         baudrate: int = 57600,
 33:         bytesize: int = 8,
 34:         parity: str = "N",
 35:         stopbits: int = 1,
 36:         timeout: float = 0.6,
 37:         **_: Any,
 38:     ) -> None:
 39:         from extern.kaleido import KaleidoPort
 40:         self._driver = KaleidoPort()
 41:         self._mode = mode
 42:         self._host = host
 43:         self._port = port
 44:         self._path = path
 45:         self._comport = comport
 46:         self._baudrate = baudrate
 47:         self._bytesize = bytesize
 48:         self._parity = parity
 49:         self._stopbits = stopbits
 50:         self._timeout = timeout
 51:         self._connected: bool = False
 52: 
 53:     async def connect(self) -> None:
 54:         serial = None
 55:         if self._mode.lower() == "serial":
 56:             if not self._comport:
 57:                 raise ValueError("Kaleido Serial 모드: comport가 비어 있음.")
 58:             # extern/kaleido.py의 SerialSettings TypedDict 필드와 1:1 매칭.
 59:             serial = {
 60:                 "port": self._comport,
 61:                 "baudrate": self._baudrate,
 62:                 "bytesize": self._bytesize,
 63:                 "stopbits": self._stopbits,
 64:                 "parity": self._parity,
 65:                 "timeout": self._timeout,
 66:                 "clear_HUPCL": False,
 67:             }
 68:         self._driver.start(
 69:             mode="C",  # 온도 단위(C/F): roaster registry에서 항상 C 모드 가정
 70:             host=self._host,
 71:             port=self._port,
 72:             path=self._path,
 73:             serial=serial,
 74:         )
 75:         # ws_initialize()가 Ping→TU→SC 핸드셰이크를 백그라운드에서 수행.
 76:         # sid와 TU가 모두 설정되면 초기화 완료.
 77:         deadline = time.monotonic() + _CONNECT_TIMEOUT
 78:         while time.monotonic() < deadline:
 79:             await asyncio.sleep(_CONNECT_POLL)
 80:             if self._driver.get_state("sid") is not None and self._driver.get_state("TU") is not None:
 81:                 self._connected = True
 82:                 _log.info("Kaleido connected (mode=%s, TU=%s)", self._mode, self._driver.get_state("TU"))
 83:                 return
 84:         raise ConnectionError(f"Kaleido 핸드셰이크 타임아웃 ({_CONNECT_TIMEOUT}s): Ping→TU→SC 미완료")
 85: 
 86:     async def disconnect(self) -> None:
 87:         self._driver.stop()
 88:         self._connected = False
 89: 
 90:     async def read(self) -> Reading:
 91:         bt, et, _sid = self._driver.getBTET()
 92:         try:
 93:             hp = float(self._driver.get_state("HP") or 0)
 94:         except (KeyError, TypeError):
 95:             hp = 0.0
 96:         try:
 97:             fc = float(self._driver.get_state("FC") or 0)  # fan: FC (not SM)
 98:         except (KeyError, TypeError):
 99:             fc = 0.0
100:         try:
101:             drum = float(self._driver.get_state("RC") or 0)  # drum: RC (not RL)
102:         except (KeyError, TypeError):
103:             drum = 0.0
104:         return Reading(bt=bt, et=et, heater=hp, fan=fc, drum=drum, timestamp=time.monotonic())
105: 
106:     async def control(self, heater: float | None = None, fan: float | None = None, drum: float | None = None) -> None:
107:         pass  # 제어 기능 미사용 — 제거 예정
108: 
109:     @property
110:     def connected(self) -> bool:
111:         return self._connected
</file>

<file path="src-tauri/sidecar/adapters/modbus.py">
  1: import asyncio
  2: import struct
  3: import time
  4: import logging
  5: from typing import Any
  6: from pymodbus.framer import FramerType
  7: from adapters.base import Reading
  8: 
  9: _log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 10: 
 11: # 500ms 폴링 기준으로 artisan 공식 min(delay/2000, 0.4)에 정렬.
 12: # delay=500ms → cap=0.25s. TCP는 0.25s, RTU는 0.3s(시리얼 응답 지연 여유).
 13: # 한 폴링 사이클에서 채널 3개(BT/ET/drum)를 순차 read하므로,
 14: # 채널당 worst-case = timeout × (1 + retries) 가 사이클 예산을 너무 넘기지 않게 한다.
 15: _TCP_TIMEOUT = 0.25
 16: _RTU_TIMEOUT = 0.3
 17: _RTU_CONNECT_DELAY = 0.5  # Artisan modbus_serial_connect_delay — 느린 RTU 장비 대응
 18: 
 19: 
 20: def _bcd_decode(raw: int) -> int:
 21:     """BCD 인코딩된 정수를 10진수로 변환. 예: 0x0212 → 212."""
 22:     result = 0
 23:     factor = 1
 24:     while raw:
 25:         result += (raw & 0xF) * factor
 26:         raw >>= 4
 27:         factor *= 10
 28:     return result
 29: 
 30: 
 31: class ModbusAdapter:
 32:     """
 33:     MODBUS TCP/RTU 어댑터 (Diedrich, Easyster, Proaster, Trinitas, Probat Probatone, Loring).
 34:     pymodbus 3.x AsyncModbusTcpClient / AsyncModbusSerialClient 사용.
 35: 
 36:     mode="tcp" → TCP (host, port)
 37:     mode="rtu" → Serial RTU (comport, baudrate)
 38: 
 39:     modbus_registers: roaster_registry의 "modbus_registers" 필드.
 40:       {
 41:         "BT": {"register": N, "func": 1|2|3|4, "unit_id": N,
 42:                "float": bool, "div": 0|1|2, "mode": "C"|"F",
 43:                "signed": bool},
 44:         "ET": {...} or None,
 45:       }
 46:     func=1 → Read Coils           (bit)
 47:     func=2 → Read Discrete Inputs (bit)
 48:     func=3 → Read Holding Registers
 49:     func=4 → Read Input Registers
 50:     float=True  → 2레지스터 IEEE 32-bit float (Diedrich CR/DR)
 51:     div=1  → ÷10, div=2 → ÷100
 52:     mode="F" → °F → °C 변환 (Diedrich, Loring)
 53:     signed=True → 16-bit signed integer 해석
 54: 
 55:     word_order="little" (기본) → Artisan wordorderLittle=True와 동일.
 56:                                   float 2레지스터를 [low, high] 순서로 해석.
 57:     word_order="big"           → [high, low] 순서.
 58:     """
 59: 
 60:     def __init__(
 61:         self,
 62:         mode: str = "tcp",
 63:         host: str = "127.0.0.1",
 64:         port: int = 502,
 65:         comport: str = "",
 66:         baudrate: int = 9600,
 67:         bytesize: int = 8,
 68:         parity: str = "N",
 69:         stopbits: float = 1,
 70:         interval: float = 1.0,
 71:         word_order: str = "little",
 72:         modbus_registers: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
 73:         **_: Any,
 74:     ) -> None:
 75:         self._mode = mode.lower()
 76:         self._host = host
 77:         self._port = port
 78:         self._comport = comport
 79:         self._baudrate = baudrate
 80:         self._bytesize = bytesize
 81:         self._parity = parity
 82:         self._stopbits = int(stopbits)
 83:         self._interval = interval
 84:         self._word_order = word_order.lower()  # "little" | "big"
 85:         self._regs: dict[str, Any] = modbus_registers or {}
 86:         self._client: Any = None
 87:         # Artisan 기본값: TCP readRetries=0, serial_readRetries=1.
 88:         # 우리도 동일하게 모드별 차등 — 500ms 폴링 사이클 안에 들어오도록.
 89:         # TODO(T36): RTU는 시리얼 응답이 본질적으로 느려서 500ms 폴링에는 빠듯함.
 90:         #   채널 3개 retry 한 번 들어가면 worst-case 1.8s → 폴링 cycle 누락 가능.
 91:         #   UI에서 RTU 머신 선택 시 pollIntervalMs를 자동으로 1000ms로 올리는 옵션 필요.
 92:         #   (artisan 권장도 RTU=1s 폴링)
 93:         self._read_retries: int = 0 if self._mode == "tcp" else 1
 94:         self._consecutive_errors: int = 0
 95:         self._acceptable_errors: int = 3  # 3회 연속 실패까지 last-reading 유지, 그 뒤 disconnect
 96:         self._last_reading: Reading | None = None
 97: 
 98:     async def connect(self) -> None:
 99:         from pymodbus.client import AsyncModbusTcpClient, AsyncModbusSerialClient  # type: ignore[import]
100: 
101:         if not self._regs:
102:             raise ValueError(
103:                 "modbus_registers가 비어 있음. roaster_registry 확인 필요."
104:             )
105: 
106:         if self._mode == "tcp":
107:             self._client = AsyncModbusTcpClient(
108:                 host=self._host, port=self._port, timeout=_TCP_TIMEOUT
109:             )
110:             _log.info(
111:                 "ModbusAdapter connecting: TCP %s:%d timeout=%.1fs",
112:                 self._host,
113:                 self._port,
114:                 _TCP_TIMEOUT,
115:             )
116:         else:
117:             self._client = AsyncModbusSerialClient(
118:                 port=self._comport,
119:                 framer=FramerType.RTU,
120:                 baudrate=self._baudrate,
121:                 bytesize=self._bytesize,
122:                 parity=self._parity,
123:                 stopbits=self._stopbits,
124:                 timeout=_RTU_TIMEOUT,
125:             )
126:             _log.info(
127:                 "ModbusAdapter connecting: RTU port=%s baudrate=%d bytesize=%d parity=%s stopbits=%g timeout=%.1fs",
128:                 self._comport,
129:                 self._baudrate,
130:                 self._bytesize,
131:                 self._parity,
132:                 self._stopbits,
133:                 _RTU_TIMEOUT,
134:             )
135: 
136:         await self._client.connect()
137:         if not self._client.connected:
138:             raise ConnectionError(
139:                 f"MODBUS 연결 실패: "
140:                 f"{'%s:%d' % (self._host, self._port) if self._mode == 'tcp' else self._comport}"
141:             )
142:         if self._mode != "tcp":
143:             await asyncio.sleep(_RTU_CONNECT_DELAY)
144:         else:
145:             await asyncio.sleep(0.3)  # Artisan: "avoid possible hickups on startup"
146:         _log.info("ModbusAdapter connected OK (mode=%s)", self._mode)
147: 
148:     async def disconnect(self) -> None:
149:         if self._client is not None:
150:             self._client.close()
151:             self._client = None
152: 
153:     async def _read_channel(self, cfg: dict[str, Any]) -> float:
154:         """단일 채널(BT 또는 ET) 읽기. retry 포함."""
155:         register: int = cfg["register"]
156:         func: int = cfg["func"]
157:         unit_id: int = cfg["unit_id"]
158:         is_float: bool = cfg.get("float", False)
159:         div: int = cfg.get("div", 0)
160:         temp_mode: str = cfg.get("mode", "C")
161:         is_signed: bool = cfg.get("signed", False)
162:         # func=1/2(bit): count=1, func=3/4: float/bcd(32bit)→2, bcd16/int→1
163:         is_bcd32 = cfg.get("bcd", False)
164:         is_bcd16 = cfg.get("bcd_as_int", False)
165:         count = 1 if func in (1, 2) else (2 if (is_float or is_bcd32) else 1)
166: 
167:         last_exc: Exception = RuntimeError("MODBUS 읽기 실패")
168:         for attempt in range(self._read_retries + 1):
169:             try:
170:                 _log.debug(
171:                     "READ attempt %d: func=%d register=%d(0x%04X) count=%d unit=%d",
172:                     attempt + 1,
173:                     func,
174:                     register,
175:                     register,
176:                     count,
177:                     unit_id,
178:                 )
179:                 if func == 1:
180:                     result = await self._client.read_coils(
181:                         register, count=count, device_id=unit_id
182:                     )
183:                 elif func == 2:
184:                     result = await self._client.read_discrete_inputs(
185:                         register, count=count, device_id=unit_id
186:                     )
187:                 elif func == 3:
188:                     result = await self._client.read_holding_registers(
189:                         register, count=count, device_id=unit_id
190:                     )
191:                 else:
192:                     result = await self._client.read_input_registers(
193:                         register, count=count, device_id=unit_id
194:                     )
195: 
196:                 if result.isError():
197:                     raise IOError(
198:                         f"MODBUS 오류 응답: func={func} register={register} unit={unit_id} → {result}"
199:                     )
200: 
201:                 # func=1/2: bit 반환
202:                 if func in (1, 2):
203:                     _log.debug("READ OK: bits=%s", result.bits)
204:                     return float(result.bits[0]) if result.bits else 0.0
205: 
206:                 _log.debug("READ OK: registers=%s", result.registers)
207: 
208:                 if is_float:
209:                     # word_order="little": [low_word, high_word] → 스왑 후 big-endian unpack
210:                     if self._word_order == "little":
211:                         raw = struct.pack(
212:                             ">HH", result.registers[1], result.registers[0]
213:                         )
214:                     else:
215:                         raw = struct.pack(
216:                             ">HH", result.registers[0], result.registers[1]
217:                         )
218:                     value = struct.unpack(">f", raw)[0]
219:                 else:
220:                     if is_bcd32:
221:                         # 32-bit BCD: 2 registers (Artisan inputBCDs, Loring temp channels)
222:                         if self._word_order == "little":
223:                             raw32 = (result.registers[1] << 16) | result.registers[0]
224:                         else:
225:                             raw32 = (result.registers[0] << 16) | result.registers[1]
226:                         raw_int = _bcd_decode(raw32)
227:                     elif is_bcd16:
228:                         # 16-bit BCD: 1 register (Artisan inputBCDsAsInt, Loring drum %)
229:                         raw_int = _bcd_decode(result.registers[0])
230:                     elif is_signed and result.registers[0] >= 0x8000:
231:                         raw_int = result.registers[0] - 0x10000
232:                     else:
233:                         raw_int = result.registers[0]
234: 
235:                     value = float(raw_int)
236: 
237:                     if div == 1:
238:                         value /= 10.0
239:                     elif div == 2:
240:                         value /= 100.0
241: 
242:                 if temp_mode == "F":
243:                     value = (value - 32.0) * 5.0 / 9.0
244: 
245:                 return round(value, 1)
246:             except Exception as exc:
247:                 last_exc = exc
248:                 _log.warning(
249:                     "MODBUS 읽기 실패 (attempt %d/%d): register=%d unit=%d — %s",
250:                     attempt + 1,
251:                     self._read_retries + 1,
252:                     register,
253:                     unit_id,
254:                     exc,
255:                 )
256:         raise last_exc
257: 
258:     async def read(self) -> Reading:
259:         if self._client is None or not self._client.connected:
260:             raise ConnectionError("MODBUS 클라이언트가 연결되지 않음")
261: 
262:         bt_cfg = self._regs.get("BT")
263:         et_cfg = self._regs.get("ET")
264:         drum_cfg = self._regs.get("drum")
265: 
266:         try:
267:             bt = await self._read_channel(bt_cfg) if bt_cfg else -1.0
268:             et = await self._read_channel(et_cfg) if et_cfg else -1.0
269:             drum = await self._read_channel(drum_cfg) if drum_cfg else 0.0
270:         except Exception as exc:
271:             self._consecutive_errors += 1
272:             if (
273:                 self._consecutive_errors <= self._acceptable_errors
274:                 and self._last_reading is not None
275:             ):
276:                 _log.warning(
277:                     "읽기 실패 (%d/%d회), 이전 값 유지: %s",
278:                     self._consecutive_errors,
279:                     self._acceptable_errors,
280:                     exc,
281:                 )
282:                 # timestamp 갱신: RoR 윈도우 슬라이딩이 멈추지 않도록
283:                 return Reading(
284:                     bt=self._last_reading.bt,
285:                     et=self._last_reading.et,
286:                     heater=self._last_reading.heater,
287:                     fan=self._last_reading.fan,
288:                     drum=self._last_reading.drum,
289:                     timestamp=time.monotonic(),
290:                 )
291:             raise
292: 
293:         self._consecutive_errors = 0
294:         reading = Reading(
295:             bt=bt, et=et, heater=0.0, fan=0.0, drum=drum, timestamp=time.monotonic()
296:         )
297:         self._last_reading = reading
298:         return reading
299: 
300:     async def control(
301:         self,
302:         heater: float | None = None,
303:         fan: float | None = None,
304:         drum: float | None = None,
305:     ) -> None:
306:         pass  # 제어 기능 미사용 — 제거 예정
307: 
308:     @property
309:     def connected(self) -> bool:
310:         return self._client is not None and self._client.connected
</file>

<file path="src-tauri/sidecar/adapters/phidget.py">
  1: import asyncio
  2: import time
  3: import logging
  4: from typing import Any
  5: 
  6: from adapters.base import Reading
  7: 
  8: _log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
  9: 
 10: 
 11: class PhidgetAdapter:
 12:     """
 13:     Phidget USB 온도 센서 어댑터 (TMP1101, TMP1200, 1048 등).
 14:     Phidget22 Python SDK 직접 사용.
 15: 
 16:     주의: pip install Phidget22 외에도 시스템 드라이버 설치 필요.
 17:       macOS: https://www.phidgets.com/docs/OS_-_macOS
 18: 
 19:     device_type: "TMP1101" | "TMP1200" | "TMP1202" | "1048"
 20:     channel_bt:  BT 채널 인덱스 (0-3)
 21:     channel_et:  ET 채널 인덱스 (0-3), None이면 ET 미사용
 22:     serial_number: 여러 Phidget 연결 시 특정 장치 지정. None이면 아무거나.
 23:     """
 24: 
 25:     _ATTACH_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000
 26: 
 27:     def __init__(
 28:         self,
 29:         device_type: str = "TMP1101",
 30:         channel_bt: int = 0,
 31:         channel_et: int | None = 1,
 32:         serial_number: int | None = None,
 33:         **_: Any,
 34:     ) -> None:
 35:         self._device_type = device_type
 36:         self._channel_bt = channel_bt
 37:         self._channel_et = channel_et
 38:         self._serial_number = serial_number
 39:         self._sensor_bt: Any = None
 40:         self._sensor_et: Any = None
 41:         self._connected: bool = False
 42: 
 43:     def _make_sensor(self, channel: int) -> Any:
 44:         from Phidget22.Devices.TemperatureSensor import TemperatureSensor  # type: ignore[import]
 45:         sensor = TemperatureSensor()
 46:         sensor.setChannel(channel)
 47:         if self._serial_number is not None:
 48:             sensor.setDeviceSerialNumber(self._serial_number)
 49:         return sensor
 50: 
 51:     async def connect(self) -> None:
 52:         def _open_sensors() -> None:
 53:             self._sensor_bt = self._make_sensor(self._channel_bt)
 54:             self._sensor_bt.openWaitForAttachment(self._ATTACH_TIMEOUT_MS)
 55:             if self._channel_et is not None:
 56:                 self._sensor_et = self._make_sensor(self._channel_et)
 57:                 self._sensor_et.openWaitForAttachment(self._ATTACH_TIMEOUT_MS)
 58: 
 59:         loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
 60:         await loop.run_in_executor(None, _open_sensors)
 61:         self._connected = True
 62:         _log.info("PhidgetAdapter connected: device=%s BT_ch=%d ET_ch=%s serial=%s",
 63:                   self._device_type, self._channel_bt, self._channel_et, self._serial_number)
 64: 
 65:     async def disconnect(self) -> None:
 66:         def _close_sensors() -> None:
 67:             for sensor in (self._sensor_bt, self._sensor_et):
 68:                 if sensor is not None:
 69:                     try:
 70:                         sensor.close()
 71:                     except Exception:
 72:                         pass
 73:             self._sensor_bt = None
 74:             self._sensor_et = None
 75: 
 76:         loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
 77:         await loop.run_in_executor(None, _close_sensors)
 78:         self._connected = False
 79: 
 80:     async def read(self) -> Reading:
 81:         if self._sensor_bt is None:
 82:             raise ConnectionError("Phidget 센서가 연결되지 않음")
 83: 
 84:         def _read_temps() -> tuple[float, float]:
 85:             try:
 86:                 bt = round(float(self._sensor_bt.getTemperature()), 1)
 87:             except Exception:
 88:                 bt = -1.0
 89:             try:
 90:                 et = round(float(self._sensor_et.getTemperature()), 1) if self._sensor_et else -1.0
 91:             except Exception:
 92:                 et = -1.0
 93:             return bt, et
 94: 
 95:         loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
 96:         bt, et = await loop.run_in_executor(None, _read_temps)
 97:         return Reading(bt=bt, et=et, heater=0.0, fan=0.0, drum=0.0, timestamp=time.monotonic())
 98: 
 99:     async def control(self, heater: float | None = None, fan: float | None = None, drum: float | None = None) -> None:
100:         pass  # 제어 기능 미사용 — 제거 예정
101: 
102:     @property
103:     def connected(self) -> bool:
104:         return self._connected
</file>

<file path="src-tauri/sidecar/adapters/probat_ws.py">
  1: import asyncio
  2: import json
  3: import random
  4: import socket
  5: import time
  6: import logging
  7: from typing import Any
  8: 
  9: from adapters.base import Reading
 10: 
 11: _log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 12: 
 13: 
 14: class ProbatWSAdapter:
 15:     """
 16:     Probat WebSocket 어댑터 (G/UG WebSockets, P Series III, Sample Roaster).
 17:     extern/wsport.py는 Qt + ApplicationWindow에 깊게 결합돼 있어 직접 구현.
 18: 
 19:     프로토콜:
 20:       ws://{host}:{port}/WebSocket
 21:       요청: {"command":"getData","id":<random>,"roasterID":0}
 22:       응답: {"id":<same>,"data":{"beanTemp":210.3,"burner":75,...}}
 23: 
 24:     channel_nodes: roaster_registry의 "channel_nodes" 딕셔너리.
 25:       {"BT":"beanTemp","ET":"ambientTemp","heater":"burner","fan":"exhaustFan"}
 26:     """
 27: 
 28:     _WS_PATH = "WebSocket"
 29:     _REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 3.0
 30:     _CONNECT_TIMEOUT = 5.0
 31: 
 32:     def __init__(
 33:         self,
 34:         host: str = "127.0.0.1",
 35:         port: int = 80,
 36:         channel_nodes: dict[str, str] | None = None,
 37:         **_: Any,
 38:     ) -> None:
 39:         self._host = host
 40:         self._port = port
 41:         self._channel_nodes: dict[str, str] = channel_nodes or {}
 42:         self._ws: Any = None
 43:         self._connected: bool = False
 44: 
 45:     def _url(self) -> str:
 46:         if self._port == 80:
 47:             return f"ws://{self._host}/{self._WS_PATH}"
 48:         return f"ws://{self._host}:{self._port}/{self._WS_PATH}"
 49: 
 50:     async def connect(self) -> None:
 51:         import websockets  # type: ignore[import]
 52: 
 53:         if not self._channel_nodes:
 54:             raise ValueError("channel_nodes가 비어 있음. roaster_registry 확인 필요.")
 55: 
 56:         self._ws = await asyncio.wait_for(
 57:             websockets.connect(
 58:                 self._url(),
 59:                 ping_interval=20,
 60:                 ping_timeout=20,
 61:                 open_timeout=self._CONNECT_TIMEOUT,
 62:                 compression="deflate",
 63:                 origin=websockets.Origin(f"http://{socket.gethostname()}"),
 64:                 user_agent_header="FC-Desktop/1.0 websockets",
 65:             ),
 66:             timeout=self._CONNECT_TIMEOUT,
 67:         )
 68:         self._connected = True
 69:         _log.info("ProbatWSAdapter connected: %s", self._url())
 70: 
 71:     async def disconnect(self) -> None:
 72:         if self._ws is not None:
 73:             try:
 74:                 await self._ws.close()
 75:             except Exception:
 76:                 pass
 77:             self._ws = None
 78:         self._connected = False
 79: 
 80:     def _on_ws_error(self, exc: Exception) -> ConnectionError:
 81:         """WS 오류 시 상태를 정리하고 ConnectionError로 변환."""
 82:         self._ws = None
 83:         self._connected = False
 84:         return ConnectionError(f"Probat WS 연결 끊김: {exc}")
 85: 
 86:     async def read(self) -> Reading:
 87:         if self._ws is None:
 88:             raise ConnectionError("WebSocket이 연결되지 않음")
 89: 
 90:         msg_id = random.randint(1, 99999)
 91:         request = json.dumps(
 92:             {"command": "getData", "id": msg_id, "roasterID": 0},
 93:             separators=(",", ":"),
 94:         )
 95:         try:
 96:             await self._ws.send(request)
 97:         except Exception as exc:
 98:             raise self._on_ws_error(exc) from exc
 99: 
100:         deadline = time.monotonic() + self._REQUEST_TIMEOUT
101:         while time.monotonic() < deadline:
102:             try:
103:                 raw = await asyncio.wait_for(
104:                     self._ws.recv(),
105:                     timeout=max(0.1, deadline - time.monotonic()),
106:                 )
107:             except asyncio.TimeoutError:
108:                 break
109:             except Exception as exc:
110:                 raise self._on_ws_error(exc) from exc
111:             try:
112:                 j = json.loads(raw)
113:             except json.JSONDecodeError:
114:                 continue
115:             if j.get("id") != msg_id:
116:                 continue
117: 
118:             data: dict[str, Any] = j.get("data", {})
119:             nodes = self._channel_nodes
120: 
121:             def _get(role: str, default: float) -> float:
122:                 node = nodes.get(role)
123:                 if node and node in data:
124:                     try:
125:                         return round(float(data[node]), 1)
126:                     except (TypeError, ValueError):
127:                         pass
128:                 return default
129: 
130:             return Reading(
131:                 bt=_get("BT", -1.0),
132:                 et=_get("ET", -1.0),
133:                 heater=_get("heater", 0.0),
134:                 fan=_get("fan", 0.0),
135:                 drum=_get("drum", 0.0),
136:                 timestamp=time.monotonic(),
137:             )
138: 
139:         raise TimeoutError(f"Probat WS getData 응답 타임아웃 (id={msg_id})")
140: 
141:     async def control(self, heater: float | None = None, fan: float | None = None, drum: float | None = None) -> None:
142:         pass  # 제어 기능 미사용 — 제거 예정
143: 
144:     @property
145:     def connected(self) -> bool:
146:         return self._connected
</file>

<file path="src-tauri/sidecar/adapters/s7.py">
  1: import asyncio
  2: import time
  3: import logging
  4: from typing import Any
  5: 
  6: from adapters.base import Reading
  7: 
  8: _log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
  9: 
 10: 
 11: class S7Adapter:
 12:     """
 13:     Siemens S7 PLC 어댑터 (Giesen, Probat S7 모델).
 14:     python-snap7 직접 사용 (extern/s7port.py는 Qt에 깊게 결합돼 있어 사용 불가).
 15: 
 16:     channels: roaster_registry의 "channels" 배열
 17:       [{"role": "BT"|"ET"|"heater"|"fan", "db": N, "offset": N, "area": 6, "type": 0|1, "div": 0|1|2}, ...]
 18:     type: 0=int (2 bytes), 1=float (4 bytes)
 19:     area: 6=DB (DataBlock) — Giesen/Probat 모두 여기
 20:     div:  0=raw, 1=÷10, 2=÷100
 21: 
 22:     snap7은 동기 API → run_in_executor로 이벤트 루프 블로킹 방지.
 23:     read_retries=1, min_request_interval=0.04s (40ms) — artisan s7port.py 기준.
 24:     """
 25: 
 26:     def __init__(
 27:         self,
 28:         host: str = "127.0.0.1",
 29:         port: int = 102,
 30:         rack: int = 0,
 31:         slot: int = 0,
 32:         channels: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
 33:         **_: Any,
 34:     ) -> None:
 35:         self._host = host
 36:         self._port = port
 37:         self._rack = rack
 38:         self._slot = slot
 39:         self._channels = channels or []
 40:         self._plc: Any = None
 41:         self._read_retries: int = 1
 42:         self._min_interval: float = 0.04
 43:         self._last_request_ts: float = 0.0
 44:         # 채널 캐시 — connect() 시 한 번만 계산
 45:         self._bt_ch: dict[str, Any] | None = None
 46:         self._et_ch: dict[str, Any] | None = None
 47:         self._hp_ch: dict[str, Any] | None = None
 48:         self._fc_ch: dict[str, Any] | None = None
 49:         self._drum_ch: dict[str, Any] | None = None
 50: 
 51:     async def connect(self) -> None:
 52:         import snap7  # type: ignore[import]
 53: 
 54:         if not self._channels:
 55:             raise ValueError("channels가 비어 있음. roaster_registry 확인 필요.")
 56: 
 57:         def _connect() -> None:
 58:             self._plc = snap7.client.Client()
 59:             self._plc.connect(self._host, self._rack, self._slot, self._port)
 60:             time.sleep(0.2)  # Artisan: wait after connect for slow PLCs
 61: 
 62:         loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
 63:         await loop.run_in_executor(None, _connect)
 64: 
 65:         if not self.connected:
 66:             raise ConnectionError(
 67:                 f"S7 연결 실패: {self._host}:{self._port} (rack={self._rack}, slot={self._slot})"
 68:             )
 69:         self._bt_ch = next((c for c in self._channels if c.get("role") == "BT"), None)
 70:         self._et_ch = next((c for c in self._channels if c.get("role") == "ET"), None)
 71:         self._hp_ch = next((c for c in self._channels if c.get("role") == "heater"), None)
 72:         self._fc_ch = next((c for c in self._channels if c.get("role") == "fan"), None)
 73:         self._drum_ch = next((c for c in self._channels if c.get("role") == "drum"), None)
 74:         _log.info("S7Adapter connected: %s:%d", self._host, self._port)
 75: 
 76:     async def disconnect(self) -> None:
 77:         def _disconnect() -> None:
 78:             if self._plc is not None:
 79:                 try:
 80:                     self._plc.disconnect()
 81:                     self._plc.destroy()
 82:                 except Exception:
 83:                     pass
 84:                 self._plc = None
 85: 
 86:         loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
 87:         await loop.run_in_executor(None, _disconnect)
 88:         self._bt_ch = self._et_ch = self._hp_ch = self._fc_ch = self._drum_ch = None
 89: 
 90:     def _throttle(self) -> None:
 91:         """요청 간 최소 간격(40ms) 보장. 스레드에서 호출."""
 92:         elapsed = time.monotonic() - self._last_request_ts
 93:         if elapsed < self._min_interval:
 94:             time.sleep(self._min_interval - elapsed)
 95:         self._last_request_ts = time.monotonic()
 96: 
 97:     def _read_channel_sync(self, ch: dict[str, Any]) -> float:
 98:         """스레드에서 실행. snap7 db_read → float 변환. retry 포함."""
 99:         from snap7.util.getters import get_real, get_int  # type: ignore[import]
100: 
101:         db: int = ch["db"]
102:         offset: int = ch["offset"]
103:         ch_type: int = ch.get("type", 0)  # 0=int(2B), 1=float(4B)
104:         div: int = ch.get("div", 0)
105:         size = 4 if ch_type == 1 else 2
106: 
107:         last_exc: Exception = RuntimeError("S7 읽기 실패")
108:         for attempt in range(self._read_retries + 1):
109:             self._throttle()
110:             try:
111:                 ba: bytearray = self._plc.db_read(db, offset, size)
112:                 if len(ba) != size:
113:                     raise IOError(f"db_read 응답 크기 불일치: {len(ba)} != {size}")
114:                 value = float(get_real(ba, 0) if ch_type == 1 else get_int(ba, 0))
115:                 if div == 1:
116:                     value /= 10.0
117:                 elif div == 2:
118:                     value /= 100.0
119:                 return round(value, 1)
120:             except Exception as exc:
121:                 last_exc = exc
122:                 _log.warning("S7 읽기 실패 (attempt %d/%d): db=%d offset=%d — %s",
123:                              attempt + 1, self._read_retries + 1, db, offset, exc)
124:         raise last_exc
125: 
126:     async def read(self) -> Reading:
127:         if not self.connected:
128:             raise ConnectionError("S7 PLC가 연결되지 않음")
129: 
130:         def _read_all() -> tuple[float, float, float, float, float]:
131:             bt = self._read_channel_sync(self._bt_ch) if self._bt_ch else -1.0
132:             et = self._read_channel_sync(self._et_ch) if self._et_ch else -1.0
133:             hp = self._read_channel_sync(self._hp_ch) if self._hp_ch else 0.0
134:             fc = self._read_channel_sync(self._fc_ch) if self._fc_ch else 0.0
135:             drum = self._read_channel_sync(self._drum_ch) if self._drum_ch else 0.0
136:             return bt, et, hp, fc, drum
137: 
138:         loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
139:         bt, et, hp, fc, drum = await loop.run_in_executor(None, _read_all)
140:         return Reading(bt=bt, et=et, heater=hp, fan=fc, drum=drum, timestamp=time.monotonic())
141: 
142:     async def control(self, heater: float | None = None, fan: float | None = None, drum: float | None = None) -> None:
143:         pass  # 제어 기능 미사용 — 제거 예정
144: 
145:     @property
146:     def connected(self) -> bool:
147:         # get_connected() can return True after peer-terminated connections (snap7 bug);
148:         # CPU state check is the reliable signal — from Artisan s7port.py
149:         try:
150:             return (self._plc is not None and
151:                     self._plc.get_connected() and
152:                     str(self._plc.get_cpu_state()) == "S7CpuStatusRun")
153:         except Exception:
154:             return False
</file>

<file path="src-tauri/sidecar/adapters/virtual.py">
  1: """
  2: 가상 로스팅 머신 시뮬레이터 — 개발/테스트용.
  3: 
  4: 세 단계로 동작한다:
  5:   1. 예열 (connect ~ enter_standby): BT가 서서히 목표 예열 온도까지 상승
  6:   2. 대기 (enter_standby ~ start_roast): BT가 예열 목표에서 안정적으로 유지
  7:   3. 로스팅 (start_roast 이후): Charge 시점 BT에서 즉각 25°C 강하 → 로스팅 커브 재생
  8: """
  9: 
 10: import math
 11: import random
 12: import time
 13: import logging
 14: from bisect import bisect_right
 15: from typing import Any
 16: 
 17: from adapters.base import Reading
 18: 
 19: _log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 20: 
 21: 
 22: # ── 선형 보간 ──────────────────────────────────────────────
 23: 
 24: 
 25: def _interp(x: float, xp: list[float], fp: list[float]) -> float:
 26:     if x <= xp[0]:
 27:         return fp[0]
 28:     if x >= xp[-1]:
 29:         return fp[-1]
 30:     i = bisect_right(xp, x)
 31:     x0, x1 = xp[i - 1], xp[i]
 32:     y0, y1 = fp[i - 1], fp[i]
 33:     return y0 + (y1 - y0) * (x - x0) / (x1 - x0)
 34: 
 35: 
 36: # ── 예열 시뮬레이션 파라미터 ───────────────────────────────
 37: 
 38: _PREHEAT_TARGET_BT = 210.0 # 예열 목표 BT (connect 즉시 도달)
 39: _PREHEAT_TARGET_ET = 230.0 # 예열 목표 ET (connect 즉시 도달)
 40: 
 41: # Charge 시 즉각 강하량 — 실제 생두 투입 시 20~30°C 강하
 42: _CHARGE_DROP = 25.0
 43: 
 44: 
 45: # ── 로스팅 프로파일 ────────────────────────────────────────
 46: #
 47: # t=0 = Charge (생두 투입) 시점. 기준 온도 200°C.
 48: # 처음 15초에 25°C 즉각 강하 → 90초에 TP → 이후 로스팅 상승.
 49: 
 50: def _build_roast_profile() -> dict[str, Any]:
 51:     """0~780초(13분) 로스팅 프로파일. 기준 BT 200°C (실제 charge BT와의 차이는 오프셋 적용)."""
 52:     times: list[float] = []
 53:     bts: list[float] = []
 54:     ets: list[float] = []
 55: 
 56:     for t in range(0, 781, 5):
 57:         # BT: 실제 로스팅 머신과 유사한 곡선
 58:         #   0~20s  : charge 충격으로 급강하 (22°C/20s)
 59:         #   20~120s: 완만하게 TP(145°C)로 하강
 60:         #   120~180s: TP 이후 완만 회복 (건조 시작)
 61:         #   180~360s: Maillard — 온도 상승 가속
 62:         #   360~540s: 1C 접근
 63:         #   540~660s: 1C ~ Development
 64:         #   660~780s: Drop 직전 마무리
 65:         if t <= 20:
 66:             bt = 200.0 - (22.0 * t) / 20.0
 67:         elif t <= 120:
 68:             bt = 178.0 - (33.0 * (t - 20)) / 100.0
 69:         elif t <= 180:
 70:             bt = 145.0 + (7.0 * (t - 120)) / 60.0
 71:         elif t <= 360:
 72:             bt = 152.0 + (22.0 * (t - 180)) / 180.0
 73:         elif t <= 540:
 74:             bt = 174.0 + (19.0 * (t - 360)) / 180.0
 75:         elif t <= 660:
 76:             bt = 193.0 + (7.0 * (t - 540)) / 120.0
 77:         else:
 78:             bt = 200.0 + (8.0 * (t - 660)) / 120.0
 79: 
 80:         # ET: 드럼 환경 온도 — 항상 BT보다 높고 완만하게 상승
 81:         #   0~30s  : 생두 투입 충격으로 소폭 강하
 82:         #   30~90s : 회복
 83:         #   90~420s: 완만한 상승 (Maillard 진행)
 84:         #   420~780s: 지속 상승
 85:         if t <= 30:
 86:             et = 230.0 - (12.0 * t) / 30.0
 87:         elif t <= 90:
 88:             et = 218.0 + (6.0 * (t - 30)) / 60.0
 89:         elif t <= 420:
 90:             et = 224.0 + (10.0 * (t - 90)) / 330.0
 91:         else:
 92:             et = 234.0 + (8.0 * (t - 420)) / 360.0
 93: 
 94:         times.append(float(t))
 95:         bts.append(round(bt, 2))
 96:         ets.append(round(et, 2))
 97: 
 98:     return {"timex": times, "bt": bts, "et": ets}
 99: 
100: 
101: _ROAST_PROFILE = _build_roast_profile()
102: 
103: 
104: # ── 노이즈 ────────────────────────────────────────────────
105: 
106: 
107: def _noise(scale: float = 0.3) -> float:
108:     """±scale °C 범위의 부드러운 노이즈."""
109:     return (random.random() * 2 - 1) * scale
110: 
111: 
112: # ── 어댑터 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
113: 
114: 
115: class VirtualMachineAdapter:
116:     """개발/테스트용 가상 머신 어댑터.
117: 
118:     connect() → 예열 상승
119:     enter_standby() → 예열 목표 온도에서 안정 유지 (강하 없음)
120:     start_roast() → Charge 시점 BT 기록 후 로스팅 커브 재생
121:     """
122: 
123:     def __init__(self, mode: str = "C", **_: Any) -> None:
124:         self._connected: bool = False
125:         self._roasting: bool = False
126:         self._connect_time: float = 0.0
127:         self._roast_start_time: float = 0.0
128:         self._charge_bt: float = _PREHEAT_TARGET_BT  # Charge 시점 BT
129:         self._standby_time: float = 0.0  # enter_standby() 호출 시각
130: 
131:     async def connect(self) -> None:
132:         self._connect_time = time.monotonic()
133:         self._roasting = False
134:         self._standby_time = 0.0
135:         self._charge_bt = _PREHEAT_TARGET_BT
136:         self._connected = True
137:         _log.info("VirtualMachine connected — preheating")
138: 
139:     async def disconnect(self) -> None:
140:         self._connected = False
141:         self._roasting = False
142: 
143:     async def read(self) -> Reading:
144:         if not self._connected:
145:             return Reading(bt=-1.0, et=-1.0, heater=0, fan=0, drum=0, timestamp=time.monotonic())
146: 
147:         if not self._roasting:
148:             return self._read_preheat()
149:         else:
150:             return self._read_roasting()
151: 
152:     def _read_preheat(self) -> Reading:
153:         """예열 + 대기 단계: standby 진입 10초 후 BT를 5°C/s로 최대 25°C 강하 → auto-charge 유발."""
154:         bt_base = _PREHEAT_TARGET_BT
155:         if self._standby_time > 0:
156:             elapsed = time.monotonic() - self._standby_time - 10.0
157:             if elapsed > 0:
158:                 bt_base -= min(elapsed * 5.0, 25.0)
159: 
160:         bt = bt_base + _noise(0.4)
161:         et = _PREHEAT_TARGET_ET + _noise(0.3)
162: 
163:         heater = 60.0
164:         fan = 20.0
165:         drum = 50.0
166: 
167:         return Reading(
168:             bt=round(bt, 1),
169:             et=round(et, 1),
170:             heater=round(heater, 1),
171:             fan=fan,
172:             drum=drum,
173:             timestamp=time.monotonic(),
174:         )
175: 
176:     async def enter_standby(self) -> None:
177:         """READY 버튼 → 10초 후 BT 강하 시작, auto-charge 감지 유발."""
178:         self._standby_time = time.monotonic()
179:         _log.info("VirtualMachine: standby entered — bean drop in 10s")
180: 
181:     def _read_roasting(self) -> Reading:
182:         """로스팅 단계: Charge BT 기준 오프셋 적용 후 프로파일 보간."""
183:         tx = time.monotonic() - self._roast_start_time
184: 
185:         bt_profile = _interp(tx, _ROAST_PROFILE["timex"], _ROAST_PROFILE["bt"])
186:         et_profile = _interp(tx, _ROAST_PROFILE["timex"], _ROAST_PROFILE["et"])
187: 
188:         # Charge 시점 실제 BT가 기준(200°C)과 다를 경우 오프셋 적용
189:         bt_offset = self._charge_bt - _PREHEAT_TARGET_BT
190:         bt = bt_profile + bt_offset + _noise(0.4)
191:         et = et_profile + bt_offset * 0.3 + _noise(0.25)
192: 
193:         heater = max(40.0, 75.0 - (tx / 780.0) * 25.0)
194:         fan = min(70.0, 30.0 + (tx / 780.0) * 40.0)
195:         drum = 50.0
196: 
197:         return Reading(
198:             bt=round(bt, 1),
199:             et=round(et, 1),
200:             heater=round(heater, 1),
201:             fan=round(fan, 1),
202:             drum=drum,
203:             timestamp=time.monotonic(),
204:         )
205: 
206:     async def start_roast(self) -> None:
207:         """Charge 시점. 현재 BT를 기록하고 로스팅 커브 재생 시작."""
208:         # Charge 직전 예열 온도를 캡처해 로스팅 프로파일 오프셋에 사용
209:         preheat = self._read_preheat()
210:         self._charge_bt = preheat.bt
211:         self._roast_start_time = time.monotonic()
212:         self._roasting = True
213:         _log.info("VirtualMachine: charge at BT=%.1f°C — roasting started", self._charge_bt)
214: 
215:     async def control(
216:         self,
217:         heater: float | None = None,
218:         fan: float | None = None,
219:         drum: float | None = None,
220:     ) -> None:
221:         pass  # 제어 기능 미사용 — 제거 예정
222: 
223:     @property
224:     def connected(self) -> bool:
225:         return self._connected

  1: """Unit tests for RoasterManager."""

 14: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15: # _least_squares_slope
 16: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17: 
 18: class TestLeastSquaresSlope:
 19:     def _slope(self, window):
 20:         m = RoasterManager()
 21:         return m._least_squares_slope(deque(window))
 22: 
 23:     def test_empty_returns_zero(self):
 24:         assert self._slope([]) == 0.0
 25: 
 26:     def test_single_point_returns_zero(self):
 27:         assert self._slope([(0.0, 150.0)]) == 0.0
 28: 
 29:     def test_constant_temp_returns_zero(self):
 30:         pts = [(float(i), 150.0) for i in range(5)]
 31:         assert self._slope(pts) == pytest.approx(0.0, abs=1e-6)
 32: 
 33:     def test_exact_linear_rise(self):
 34:         # 10 °C/min = 10/60 °C/s → over 60s should give slope = 10.0
 35:         t0 = 0.0
 36:         pts = [(t0 + i * 6.0, 150.0 + i * 1.0) for i in range(11)]  # 6s intervals, 1°C each
 37:         slope = self._slope(pts)
 38:         # 1°C per 6s = 10°C/min
 39:         assert slope == pytest.approx(10.0, rel=1e-4)
 40: 
 41:     def test_negative_slope(self):
 42:         pts = [(float(i * 6), 200.0 - i * 1.0) for i in range(11)]
 43:         slope = self._slope(pts)
 44:         assert slope == pytest.approx(-10.0, rel=1e-4)
 45: 
 46:     def test_returns_per_minute_not_per_second(self):
 47:         # Two points 60s apart with 5°C rise → slope = 5 °C/min
 48:         pts = [(0.0, 150.0), (60.0, 155.0)]
 49:         assert self._slope(pts) == pytest.approx(5.0, rel=1e-4)
 50: 
 51:     def test_identical_timestamps_returns_zero(self):
 52:         pts = [(5.0, 150.0), (5.0, 160.0)]
 53:         assert self._slope(pts) == 0.0

<file path="supabase/migrations/20260607210000_add_recurrence_rules.sql">
  1: -- Create recurrence_rules master table for managing recurring roast batches
  2: -- This replaces the previous approach of expanding RRULE into individual rows
  3: -- 
  4: -- Migration strategy:
  5: -- 1. Create recurrence_rules table (Master)
  6: -- 2. Modify roast_plan_batches to add recurrence_rule_id FK + exception columns
  7: -- 3. Backfill: migrate existing rrule + recurrence_group_id data
  8: -- 4. Legacy columns (rrule, recurrence_group_id) will be dropped later
  9: 
 10: -- ── 1. Create recurrence_rules master table ──────────────────────────────────
 11: 
 12: CREATE TABLE public.recurrence_rules (
 13:     id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 14:     rrule TEXT NOT NULL,
 15:     dtstart DATE NOT NULL,
 16:     "until" DATE,                                   -- NULL = indefinite
 17:     status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'cancelled')),
 18:     user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 19:     machine_id TEXT,
 20:     roast_profile_id UUID REFERENCES public.roast_profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 21:     bean_id UUID REFERENCES public.beans(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 22:     bean_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 23:     green_lot TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 24:     batch_size_kg NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 25:     yield_pct NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 26:     target_roasted_kg NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 27:     notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 28:     batch_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 29:     created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
 30:     updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
 31: );
 32: 
 33: COMMENT ON TABLE public.recurrence_rules IS 'Master RRULE definitions for recurring roast batches';
 34: COMMENT ON COLUMN public.recurrence_rules.rrule IS 'RFC 5545 RRULE string (e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2)';
 35: COMMENT ON COLUMN public.recurrence_rules.dtstart IS 'Start date for the recurrence';
 36: COMMENT ON COLUMN public.recurrence_rules."until" IS 'End date for the recurrence. NULL = indefinite (active until cancelled)';
 37: COMMENT ON COLUMN public.recurrence_rules.status IS 'active | cancelled';
 38: 
 39: -- ── 2. Modify roast_plan_batches — add recurrence_rule_id + exception columns ─
 40: 
 41: ALTER TABLE public.roast_plan_batches
 42:     ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recurrence_rule_id UUID REFERENCES public.recurrence_rules(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 43:     ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS scheduled_date DATE,
 44:     ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS original_date DATE,
 45:     ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS exception_type TEXT CHECK (exception_type IN ('modified', 'cancelled'));
 46: 
 47: COMMENT ON COLUMN public.roast_plan_batches.recurrence_rule_id IS 'FK to recurrence_rules. NULL = one-off batch';
 48: COMMENT ON COLUMN public.roast_plan_batches.scheduled_date IS 'The date this batch instance is scheduled for';
 49: COMMENT ON COLUMN public.roast_plan_batches.original_date IS 'Original recurrence date. Used to match exception rows during merge';
 50: COMMENT ON COLUMN public.roast_plan_batches.exception_type IS 'NULL = normal (data from Master), modified = overridden, cancelled = hidden during merge';
 51: 
 52: -- ── 3. Backfill: migrate existing recurrence data ─────────────────────────────
 53: -- Existing rows with recurrence_group_id represent expanded instances of
 54: -- the same recurrence. We group them by recurrence_group_id + rrule + user_id
 55: -- to reconstruct a recurrence_rules master record, then link back.
 56: 
 57: DO $$
 58: DECLARE
 59:     rec RECORD;
 60:     new_rule_id UUID;
 61: BEGIN
 62:     FOR rec IN (
 63:         SELECT DISTINCT ON (b.recurrence_group_id)
 64:             b.recurrence_group_id,
 65:             b.rrule,
 66:             b.machine_id,
 67:             b.bean_id,
 68:             b.bean_name,
 69:             b.green_lot,
 70:             b.batch_size_kg,
 71:             b.yield_pct,
 72:             b.target_roasted_kg,
 73:             b.notes,
 74:             b.batch_type,
 75:             b.roast_profile_id,
 76:             p.user_id
 77:         FROM roast_plan_batches b
 78:         JOIN roast_day_plans p ON p.id = b.plan_id
 79:         WHERE b.recurrence_group_id IS NOT NULL
 80:           AND b.rrule IS NOT NULL
 81:         ORDER BY b.recurrence_group_id, p.date ASC
 82:     ) LOOP
 83:         INSERT INTO public.recurrence_rules (
 84:             rrule, dtstart, user_id,
 85:             machine_id, bean_id, bean_name, green_lot,
 86:             batch_size_kg, yield_pct, target_roasted_kg,
 87:             notes, batch_type, roast_profile_id
 88:         )
 89:         VALUES (
 90:             rec.rrule,
 91:             (SELECT MIN(p2.date::DATE) FROM roast_plan_batches b2
 92:              JOIN roast_day_plans p2 ON p2.id = b2.plan_id
 93:              WHERE b2.recurrence_group_id = rec.recurrence_group_id),
 94:             rec.user_id,
 95:             rec.machine_id,
 96:             rec.bean_id,
 97:             rec.bean_name,
 98:             rec.green_lot,
 99:             rec.batch_size_kg,
100:             rec.yield_pct,
101:             rec.target_roasted_kg,
102:             rec.notes,
103:             rec.batch_type,
104:             rec.roast_profile_id
105:         )
106:         RETURNING id INTO new_rule_id;
107: 
108:         UPDATE roast_plan_batches
109:         SET recurrence_rule_id = new_rule_id,
110:             scheduled_date = roast_day_plans.date
111:         FROM roast_day_plans
112:         WHERE roast_day_plans.id = roast_plan_batches.plan_id
113:           AND roast_plan_batches.recurrence_group_id = rec.recurrence_group_id;
114:     END LOOP;
115: END $$;
116: 
117: -- ── 4. RLS + Grants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
118: 
119: ALTER TABLE public.recurrence_rules ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
120: 
121: CREATE POLICY "users can manage own recurrence_rules"
122:     ON public.recurrence_rules
123:     FOR ALL
124:     USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
125: 
126: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.recurrence_rules TO authenticated;
</file>
