301:      * - If recurrence_rule_id is present: insert a cancelled exception row
302:      * - If recurrence_rule_id is null: delete the row directly (one-off batch)
303:      */
304:     deleteSingle: async (
305:         id: string,
306:         meta?: { recurrenceRuleId?: string; originalDate?: string; planId?: string },
307:     ): Promise<void> => {
308:         if (meta?.recurrenceRuleId && meta?.originalDate) {
309:             // Recurring batch → insert cancelled exception

311:                 .from('roast_plan_batches')

314:                     recurrence_rule_id: meta.recurrenceRuleId,
315:                     scheduled_date: meta.originalDate,

334:     /**
335:      * Delete all future instances from a given date onward (from_this).
336:      * Closes the existing recurrence_rules.until to (fromDate - 1).
337:      */
338:     deleteFromThis: async (ruleId: string, fromDate: string): Promise<void> => {
339:         // Set until to the day before fromDate, effectively truncating
340:         const untilDate = new Date(fromDate);
341:         untilDate.setDate(untilDate.getDate() - 1);
342:         const untilStr = format(untilDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
343: 
344:         const { error } = await supabase
345:             .from('recurrence_rules')
346:             .update({ until: untilStr })

348:         if (error) throw error;

354:     deleteAll: async (ruleId: string): Promise<void> => {
355:         const { error } = await supabase
356:             .from('recurrence_rules')
357:             .update({ status: 'cancelled' })
358:             .eq('id', ruleId);
359:         if (error) throw error;

362:     /**
363:      * Update all future instances from a given date onward (from_this).
364:      * Closes existing rule's until, then creates a new recurrence_rules record
365:      * with the updated params starting from fromDate.
366:      */
367:     updateFromThis: async (
368:         ruleId: string,
369:         fromDate: string,
370:         patch: RecurrenceRuleMasterPatch & { userId: string },
371:     ): Promise<RecurrenceRule> => {
372:         const existing = await recurrenceRuleApi.get(ruleId);
373:         if (!existing) throw new Error(`Recurrence rule not found: ${ruleId}`);
374: 
375:         const untilDate = new Date(fromDate);
376:         untilDate.setDate(untilDate.getDate() - 1);
377:         const untilStr = format(untilDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
378: 
379:         const { error: closeError } = await supabase
380:             .from('recurrence_rules')
381:             .update({ until: untilStr })
382:             .eq('id', ruleId);
383:         if (closeError) throw closeError;
384: 
385:         const { userId, ...masterPatch } = patch;
386:         const merged = mergeRecurrenceRuleMaster(existing, {
387:             ...masterPatch,
388:             dtstart: masterPatch.dtstart ?? fromDate,
389:         });
390: 
391:         const newRule: RecurrenceRuleInsert = {
392:             ...merged,
393:             user_id: userId,
394:             status: 'active',
395:         };
396: 
397:         const { data, error } = await supabase
398:             .from('recurrence_rules')
399:             .insert(newRule)
400:             .select()
401:             .single();
402:         if (error) throw error;
403:         return data;
404:     },
405: 
406:     /**
407:      * Update all instances of a recurring batch.
408:      * Updates the recurrence_rules record (rrule + all master fields).
409:      */
410:     updateAll: async (ruleId: string, patch: RecurrenceRuleMasterPatch): Promise<RecurrenceRule> => {
411:         const { data, error } = await supabase
412:             .from('recurrence_rules')
413:             .update(patch)
414:             .eq('id', ruleId)
415:             .select()
416:             .single();
417:         if (error) throw error;
418:         return data;
419:     },
420: 
421:     reorder: async (planId: string, orderedIds: string[]): Promise<void> => {
422:         const updates = orderedIds.map((id, index) =>
423:             supabase.from('roast_plan_batches').update({ order_index: index }).eq('id', id),
424:         );
425:         await Promise.all(updates);
426:         // Invalidation handled by caller
427:         void planId;
428:     },
429: 
430:     /**
431:      * Create a single recurring rule (Master).
432:      * No expanded instances — rendering will compute them via listForDateRange.
433:      */
434:     createRecurring: async (
435:         _baseBatch: Omit<PlanBatchInsert, 'plan_id'>,
436:         rruleStr: string,
437:         dtstart: Date,
438:         userId: string,
439:     ): Promise<RecurrenceRule> => {
440:         const rule = await recurrenceRuleApi.create({
441:             rrule: rruleStr,
442:             dtstart: format(dtstart, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
443:             user_id: userId,
444:             machine_id: _baseBatch.machine_id,
445:             bean_id: _baseBatch.bean_id,
446:             blend_id: _baseBatch.blend_id ?? null,
447:             bean_name: _baseBatch.bean_name,
448:             green_lot: _baseBatch.green_lot ?? '',
449:             batch_size_kg: _baseBatch.batch_size_kg,
450:             yield_pct: _baseBatch.yield_pct,
451:             target_roasted_kg: _baseBatch.target_roasted_kg,
452:             notes: _baseBatch.notes ?? '',
453:             batch_type: _baseBatch.batch_type ?? '',
454:             roast_profile_id: _baseBatch.roast_profile_id,
455:         });
456:         return rule;
457:     },
458: 
459:     /**
460:      * List batches for a date range, merging recurrence rules with exception rows.
461:      * This is the rendering-time entry point — computes instances on the fly.
462:      *
463:      * @returns Array of PlanBatch-like objects (includes recurrence metadata)
464:      */
465:     listForDateRange: async (
466:         userId: string,
467:         startDate: string,
468:         endDate: string,
469:     ): Promise<PlanBatchWithProgress[]> => {
470:         // 1. Get active recurrence rules
471:         const rules = await recurrenceRuleApi.listActive(userId);
472: 
473:         // 2. Get one-off batches in the range
474:         const { data: plans, error: plansError } = await supabase
475:             .from('roast_day_plans')
476:             .select('id, date')
477:             .eq('user_id', userId)
478:             .gte('date', startDate)
479:             .lte('date', endDate);
480:         if (plansError) throw plansError;
481: 
482:         const dateToPlanId = new Map((plans ?? []).map((p) => [p.date, p.id]));
483:         const planIds = (plans ?? []).map((p) => p.id);
484: 
485:         // Get sessions for progress
486:         const { data: sessions, error: sessionsError } = await supabase
487:             .from('roast_sessions')
488:             .select('plan_batch_id')
489:             .not('plan_batch_id', 'is', null);
490:         if (sessionsError) throw sessionsError;
491: 
492:         const sessionCountMap = new Map<string, number>();
493:         for (const s of sessions ?? []) {
494:             if (s.plan_batch_id) {
495:                 sessionCountMap.set(s.plan_batch_id, (sessionCountMap.get(s.plan_batch_id) ?? 0) + 1);
496:             }
497:         }
498: 
499:         // 3. Get exception rows for recurrence rules in the date range
500:         const { data: exceptions, error: exceptionsError } = await supabase
501:             .from('roast_plan_batches')
502:             .select('*')
503:             .not('recurrence_rule_id', 'is', null)
504:             .gte('scheduled_date', startDate)
505:             .lte('scheduled_date', endDate);
506:         if (exceptionsError) throw exceptionsError;
507: 
508:         // 4. Get one-off batches (no recurrence_rule_id)
509:         const { data: oneOffBatches, error: oneOffError } = await supabase
510:             .from('roast_plan_batches')
511:             .select('*')
512:             .is('recurrence_rule_id', null)
513:             .in('plan_id', planIds);
514:         if (oneOffError) throw oneOffError;
515: 
516:         // Build result from one-off batches
517:         const result: PlanBatchWithProgress[] = (oneOffBatches ?? []).map((row) => ({
518:             ...row,
519:             completed_sessions: sessionCountMap.get(row.id) ?? 0,
520:         }));
521: 
522:         // 5. For each active recurrence rule, expand and merge with exceptions
523:         const rangeStart = new Date(startDate + 'T00:00:00');
524:         const rangeEnd = new Date(endDate + 'T23:59:59');
525: 
526:         // Dynamic import to avoid circular dependency
527:         const { expandRRuleInRange, mergeRecurrenceExceptions } = await import('@shared/lib/rrule');
528: 
529:         for (const rule of rules) {
530:             if (rule.status !== 'active') continue;
531: 
532:             // Check if rule is within range
533:             const ruleStart = new Date(rule.dtstart + 'T00:00:00');
534:             if (rule.until && new Date(rule.until + 'T23:59:59') < rangeStart) continue;
535: 
536:             // Expand dates in range
537:             const expandedDates = expandRRuleInRange(
538:                 rule.rrule,
539:                 ruleStart,
540:                 rangeStart,
541:                 rule.until ? new Date(rule.until + 'T23:59:59') : rangeEnd,
542:             );
543: 
544:             // Filter exceptions for this rule
545:             const ruleExceptions = (exceptions ?? [])
546:                 .filter((ex) => ex.recurrence_rule_id === rule.id)
547:                 .map((ex) => ({
548:                     original_date: ex.original_date ?? '',
549:                     scheduled_date: ex.scheduled_date ?? '',
550:                     exception_type: ex.exception_type as 'modified' | 'cancelled',
551:                     batch_size_kg: ex.batch_size_kg,
552:                     target_roasted_kg: ex.target_roasted_kg,
553:                     bean_id: ex.bean_id,
554:                     bean_name: ex.bean_name,
555:                     machine_id: ex.machine_id,
556:                     roast_profile_id: ex.roast_profile_id,
557:                     notes: ex.notes,
558:                     status: ex.status,
559:                 }));
560: 
561:             // Merge
562:             const instances = mergeRecurrenceExceptions(expandedDates, ruleExceptions);
563: 
564:             // For each instance, get or create the day plan and produce a batch-like row
565:             for (const instance of instances) {
566:                 if (instance.exceptionType === 'cancelled') continue;
567: 
568:                 if (instance.exceptionType === 'modified' && instance.exception) {
569:                     // Use exception data
570:                     const exBatch = exceptions?.find((e) => e.original_date === instance.originalDate);
571:                     if (exBatch) {
572:                         result.push({
573:                             ...exBatch,
574:                             completed_sessions: sessionCountMap.get(exBatch.id) ?? 0,
575:                         });
576:                     }
577:                 } else if (instance.exceptionType === 'normal') {
578:                     const planId = dateToPlanId.get(instance.date) ?? '';
579: 
580:                     const batchSize = Number(rule.batch_size_kg) || 0;
581:                     const targetKg = Number(rule.target_roasted_kg) || 0;
582:                     const batchCount =
583:                         batchSize > 0 && targetKg > 0 ? Math.ceil(targetKg / batchSize) : 1;
584: 
585:                     result.push({
586:                         id: `${rule.id}:${instance.originalDate}`,
587:                         plan_id: planId,
588:                         bean_name: rule.bean_name,
589:                         bean_id: rule.bean_id,
590:                         blend_id: rule.blend_id ?? null,
591:                         batch_type: rule.batch_type,
592:                         batch_size_kg: rule.batch_size_kg,
593:                         target_roasted_kg: rule.target_roasted_kg,
594:                         batch_count: batchCount,
595:                         yield_pct: rule.yield_pct,
596:                         order_index: 0,
597:                         machine_id: rule.machine_id,
598:                         roast_profile_id: rule.roast_profile_id,
599:                         rrule: rule.rrule,
600:                         recurrence_group_id: null,
601:                         recurrence_rule_id: rule.id,
602:                         scheduled_date: instance.date,
603:                         original_date: instance.originalDate,
604:                         exception_type: null,
605:                         notes: rule.notes,
606:                         green_lot: rule.green_lot,
607:                         status: 'pending',
608:                         created_at: rule.created_at,
609:                         updated_at: rule.updated_at,
610:                         completed_sessions: 0,
611:                     });
612:                 }
613:             }
614:         }
615: 
616:         return result;
617:     },
618: 
619:     /**
620:      * Materialize a virtual (computed) recurring batch into a real exception row.
621:      * Creates the day_plan if missing, then inserts a modified exception row.
622:      * Returns the real PlanBatch row.
623:      */
624:     materialize: async (
625:         userId: string,
626:         ruleId: string,
627:         scheduledDate: string,
628:         originalDate: string,
629:         patch: {
630:             status?: string;
631:             machine_id?: string | null;
632:             bean_id?: string | null;
633:             blend_id?: string | null;
634:             bean_name?: string;
635:             roast_profile_id?: string | null;
636:             batch_size_kg?: number;
637:             target_roasted_kg?: number;
638:             yield_pct?: number;
639:             notes?: string;
640:             green_lot?: string;
641:             batch_type?: string;
642:         },
643:     ): Promise<PlanBatch> => {
644:         const plan = await dayPlanApi.getOrCreate(userId, scheduledDate);
645: 
646:         const { data, error } = await supabase
647:             .from('roast_plan_batches')
648:             .insert({
649:                 plan_id: plan.id,
650:                 recurrence_rule_id: ruleId,
651:                 scheduled_date: scheduledDate,
652:                 original_date: originalDate,
653:                 exception_type: 'modified',
654:                 bean_name: patch.bean_name ?? '',
655:                 batch_size_kg: patch.batch_size_kg ?? 0,
656:                 target_roasted_kg: patch.target_roasted_kg ?? 0,
657:                 machine_id: patch.machine_id ?? null,
658:                 bean_id: patch.bean_id ?? null,
659:                 blend_id: patch.blend_id ?? null,
660:                 roast_profile_id: patch.roast_profile_id ?? null,
661:                 batch_type: patch.batch_type ?? 'Single Origin',
662:                 notes: patch.notes ?? '',
663:                 yield_pct: patch.yield_pct ?? 0.82,
664:                 order_index: 0,
665:                 status: patch.status ?? 'pending',
666:                 green_lot: patch.green_lot ?? '',
667:                 batch_count: 1,
668:             })
669:             .select()
670:             .single();
671:         if (error) throw error;
672:         return data;
673:     },
674: };

 85: export const useCreatePlanBatch = (planId: string) => {
 86:     const qc = useQueryClient();
 87:     return useMutation({
 88:         mutationFn: (batch: PlanBatchInsert) => planBatchApi.create(batch),
 89:         onMutate: async (batch) => {
 90:             await qc.cancelQueries({ queryKey: planKeys.batches(planId) });
 91:             const previousBatches = qc.getQueryData<PlanBatchWithProgress[]>(planKeys.batches(planId));
 92:             const now = new Date().toISOString();
 93:             const optimistic: PlanBatchWithProgress = {
 94:                 id: `__optimistic__${Date.now()}`,
 95:                 plan_id: batch.plan_id,
 96:                 bean_name: batch.bean_name,
 97:                 bean_id: batch.bean_id ?? null,
 98:                 blend_id: batch.blend_id ?? null,
 99:                 batch_type: batch.batch_type ?? '',
100:                 batch_size_kg: batch.batch_size_kg,
101:                 target_roasted_kg: batch.target_roasted_kg,
102:                 batch_count: Math.ceil(batch.target_roasted_kg / batch.batch_size_kg),
103:                 yield_pct: batch.yield_pct ?? 1,
104:                 order_index: batch.order_index ?? (previousBatches?.length ?? 0),
105:                 machine_id: batch.machine_id ?? null,
106:                 roast_profile_id: batch.roast_profile_id ?? null,

338: export const useReorderPlanBatches = (planId: string) => {
339:     const qc = useQueryClient();
340:     return useMutation({
341:         mutationFn: (orderedIds: string[]) => planBatchApi.reorder(planId, orderedIds),
342:         onMutate: async (orderedIds) => {
343:             await qc.cancelQueries({ queryKey: planKeys.batches(planId) });
344:             const previousBatches = qc.getQueryData<PlanBatchWithProgress[]>(planKeys.batches(planId));
345:             if (previousBatches) {
346:                 const byId = new Map(previousBatches.map((b) => [b.id, b]));
347:                 const optimistic = orderedIds
348:                     .map((id, index) => {
349:                         const b = byId.get(id);
350:                         return b ? { ...b, order_index: index } : null;
351:                     })
352:                     .filter((b): b is PlanBatchWithProgress => b !== null);
353:                 qc.setQueryData(planKeys.batches(planId), optimistic);
354:             }
355:             return { previousBatches };
356:         },
357:         onError: (_err, _orderedIds, context) => {
358:             if (context?.previousBatches) {
359:                 qc.setQueryData(planKeys.batches(planId), context.previousBatches);
360:             }
361:         },
362:         onSettled: () => {
363:             qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: planKeys.batches(planId) });
364:         },
365:     });
366: };

370: export const useMonthSummary = (userId: string, year: number, month: number) => {
371:     const start = format(startOfMonth(new Date(year, month)), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
372:     const end = format(endOfMonth(new Date(year, month)), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
373:     return useQuery({
374:         queryKey: planKeys.monthSummary(userId, start, end),
375:         queryFn: () => dayPlanRangeApi.listSummary(userId, start, end),
376:         enabled: !!userId,
377:         staleTime: 30_000,
378:     });
379: };
380: 
381: export const useWeekSummary = (userId: string, weekStart: Date) => {
382:     const start = format(startOfWeek(weekStart, { weekStartsOn: 1 }), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
383:     const end = format(endOfWeek(weekStart, { weekStartsOn: 1 }), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
384:     return useQuery({
385:         queryKey: planKeys.weekSummary(userId, start, end),
386:         queryFn: () => dayPlanRangeApi.listSummary(userId, start, end),
387:         enabled: !!userId,
388:         staleTime: 30_000,
389:     });
390: };

 23: /**
 24:  * Parse an RRULE string back to a RecurrenceInterval label.
 25:  * Used to pre-populate the recurrence selection when editing an existing batch.
 26:  */
 27: function parseRruleToInterval(rrule: string | null): RecurrenceInterval | null {
 28:     if (!rrule) return null;
 29:     if (rrule.includes('FREQ=DAILY')) return 'daily';
 30:     if (rrule.includes('FREQ=WEEKLY') && rrule.includes('INTERVAL=2')) return 'biweekly';
 31:     if (rrule.includes('FREQ=WEEKLY')) return 'weekly';
 32:     if (rrule.includes('FREQ=MONTHLY')) return 'monthly';
 33:     return null;
 34: }

243:                 await planBatchApi.updateSingle(editingBatch.id, {

246:                     machine_id: machineId || null,

253:                     {filteredTotal === 0
254:                         ? 'No sessions found'
255:                         : `${start}–${end} of ${filteredTotal}${filteredTotal < total ? ` (filtered from ${total})` : ''}`}
256:                 </span>
257:

259:                     <button
260:                         type="button"
261:                         onClick={() => onPageChange(page - 1)}
262:                         disabled={page === 1}

264:                     >
265:                         <ChevronLeft size={13} strokeWidth={2} />
266:                     </button>
267: 
268:                     {Array.from({ length: totalPages }, (_, i) => i + 1)
269:                         .filter((p) => p === 1 || p === totalPages || Math.abs(p - page) <= 1)
270:                         .reduce<(number | '…')[]>((acc, p, i, arr) => {
271:                             if (i > 0 && p - (arr[i - 1] as number) > 1) acc.push('…');
272:                             acc.push(p);
273:                             return acc;
274:                         }, [])
275:                         .map((item, i) =>
276:                             item === '…' ? (
277:                                 <span key={`ellipsis-${i}`} className="px-1 text-xs text-muted">
278:                                     …
279:                                 </span>
280:                             ) : (
281:                                 <button
282:                                     key={item}
283:                                     onClick={() => onPageChange(item as number)}
284:                                     className={`h-6 min-w-6 rounded px-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition ${
285:                                         page === item
286:                                             ? 'bg-surface-warm-solid text-primary'
287:                                             : 'text-muted hover:bg-surface hover:text-secondary'
288:                                     }`}
289:                                 >
290:                                     {item}
291:                                 </button>
292:                             ),
293:                         )}
294: 
295:                     <button
296:                         onClick={() => onPageChange(page + 1)}
297:                         disabled={page === totalPages || totalPages === 0}

299:                     >
300:                         <ChevronRight size={13} strokeWidth={2} />
301:                     </button>

379: type DatePreset = 'all' | 'this-month' | 'last-month' | '3-months' | '6-months' | 'this-year' | 'custom';
380: 
381: const DATE_PRESETS: { value: DatePreset; label: string }[] = [
382:     { value: 'all', label: 'All Time' },
383:     { value: 'this-month', label: 'This Month' },
384:     { value: 'last-month', label: 'Last Month' },
385:     { value: '3-months', label: 'Last 3 Months' },
386:     { value: '6-months', label: 'Last 6 Months' },
387:     { value: 'this-year', label: 'This Year' },
388:     { value: 'custom', label: 'Custom Range' },
389: ];

391: const getPresetYMRange = (preset: DatePreset): { fromYM: string; toYM: string } | null => {
392:     const now = new Date();
393:     const y = now.getFullYear();
394:     const m = now.getMonth();
395:     const fmt = (year: number, month: number) => `${year}-${String(month + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
396:     if (preset === 'this-month') return { fromYM: fmt(y, m), toYM: fmt(y, m) };
397:     if (preset === 'last-month') {
398:         const d = new Date(y, m - 1, 1);
399:         return { fromYM: fmt(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth()), toYM: fmt(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth()) };
400:     }
401:     if (preset === '3-months') {
402:         const d = new Date(y, m - 2, 1);
403:         return { fromYM: fmt(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth()), toYM: fmt(y, m) };
404:     }
405:     if (preset === '6-months') {
406:         const d = new Date(y, m - 5, 1);
407:         return { fromYM: fmt(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth()), toYM: fmt(y, m) };
408:     }
409:     if (preset === 'this-year') return { fromYM: fmt(y, 0), toYM: fmt(y, m) };
410:     return null;
411: };

415: const DateRangeFilter = ({
416:     preset,
417:     fromYM,
418:     toYM,
419:     monthOptions,
420:     onPresetChange,
421:     onFromYM,
422:     onToYM,
423: }: {
424:     preset: DatePreset;
425:     fromYM: string;
426:     toYM: string;
427:     monthOptions: string[];
428:     onPresetChange: (p: DatePreset) => void;
429:     onFromYM: (v: string) => void;
430:     onToYM: (v: string) => void;
431: }): ReactNode => {
432:     const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
433:     const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
434:     const isActive = preset !== 'all';
435: 
436:     const initFrom = fromYM || (monthOptions[0] ?? '');
437:     const initTo = toYM || (monthOptions[monthOptions.length - 1] ?? '');
438:     const [draftFrom, setDraftFrom] = useState(initFrom);
439:     const [draftTo, setDraftTo] = useState(initTo);
440: 
441:     useEffect(() => {
442:         if (!open) return;
443:         const handler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
444:             const target = e.target as Element;
445:             const inPanel = ref.current?.contains(target);
446:             const inPortal = !!target?.closest('[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]');
447:             if (!inPanel && !inPortal) setOpen(false);
448:         };
449:         document.addEventListener('mousedown', handler);
450:         return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handler);
451:     }, [open]);
452: 
453:     const years = useMemo(
454:         () => [...new Set(monthOptions.map((ym) => ym.split('-')[0]))].sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a)),
455:         [monthOptions],
456:     );
457: 
458:     const fmtLabel = (ym: string) => {
459:         if (!ym) return '—';
460:         const [y, m] = ym.split('-');
461:         return `${y}년 ${parseInt(m)}월`;
462:     };
463: 
464:     const triggerLabel = (() => {
465:         if (preset === 'custom' && (fromYM || toYM)) return `${fmtLabel(fromYM)} – ${fmtLabel(toYM)}`;
466:         return DATE_PRESETS.find((p) => p.value === preset)?.label ?? 'Period';
467:     })();
468: 
469:     const handlePresetClick = (p: DatePreset) => {
470:         if (p === 'custom') {
471:             setDraftFrom(fromYM || initFrom);
472:             setDraftTo(toYM || initTo);
473:         }
474:         onPresetChange(p);
475:         if (p !== 'custom') setOpen(false);
476:     };
477: 
478:     const handleApply = () => {
479:         let f = draftFrom;
480:         let t = draftTo;
481:         if (f && t && f > t) {
482:             [f, t] = [t, f];
483:         }
484:         onFromYM(f);
485:         onToYM(t);
486:         setOpen(false);
487:     };
488: 
489:     return (
490:         <div ref={ref} className="relative">
491:             <button
492:                 onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
493:                 className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-lg border-0 px-3 py-2 text-[13px] font-medium tracking-[0.14px] transition ${
494:                     isActive
495:                         ? 'bg-surface-warm-solid text-primary'
496:                         : 'bg-surface dark:bg-surface-elevated text-secondary hover:-translate-y-px hover:text-primary'
497:                 }`}
498:             >
499:                 {triggerLabel}
500:                 {isActive ? (
501:                     <X
502:                         size={11}
503:                         strokeWidth={2.5}
504:                         className="text-muted hover:text-primary"
505:                         onClick={(e) => {
506:                             e.stopPropagation();
507:                             onPresetChange('all');
508:                             setOpen(false);
509:                         }}
510:                     />
511:                 ) : (
512:                     <ChevronDown size={11} strokeWidth={2} className="text-muted" />
513:                 )}
514:             </button>
515: 
516:             {open && (
517:                 <div className="absolute  border border-border-subtle dark:border-[#585d61] top-full left-0 z-50 mt-2 flex rounded-lg bg-main-bg overflow-hidden">
518:                     {/* 프리셋 목록 */}
519:                     <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col gap-0.5 py-2 px-2 w-36">
520:                         {DATE_PRESETS.map((p) => (
521:                             <button
522:                                 key={p.value}
523:                                 onClick={() => handlePresetClick(p.value)}
524:                                 className={`w-full rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[13px] tracking-[0.14px] transition hover:bg-surface cursor-pointer border-none bg-transparent ${

531:                     </div>

535:                         <div className="flex flex-col justify-center gap-3 border-l border-border-subtle dark:border-[#585d61] px-5 py-4 self-stretch">

 31:     if (sec == null) return '—';

 34:     return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;

 43: const Sparkline = ({ data, color }: { data: { bt: number }[]; color: string }) => {
 44:     const W = 200;
 45:     const H = 44;
 46:     const bts = data.map((d) => d.bt);
 47:     const min = Math.min(...bts);
 48:     const max = Math.max(...bts);
 49:     const range = max - min || 1;
 50:     const pts = bts.map((v, i) => `${(i / (bts.length - 1)) * W},${H - ((v - min) / range) * H}`).join(' ');
 51:     return (
 52:         <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`} preserveAspectRatio="none" className="w-full h-11">
 53:             <polyline points={pts} fill="none" stroke={color} strokeWidth={1.5} strokeLinejoin="round" />
 54:         </svg>
 55:     );

 93:                                 className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[13px] font-medium text-primary px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-surface dark:bg-surface-elevated cursor-pointer hover:bg-surface-raised transition-colors"
 94:                             >
 95:                                 <Plus size={14} strokeWidth={2} />
 96:                                 생두 추가
 97:                             </button>
 98:                         </div>
 99:                     ) : (
100:                         <div className="grid gap-5" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '350px 1fr' }}>
101:                             <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
102:                                 <button
103:                                     onClick={() => setIsAddModalOpen(true)}
104:                                     className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-[#E5E5E5] dark:border-[#585d61] bg-transparent text-sm text-muted cursor-pointer hover:text-secondary hover:border-black/15 transition-colors tracking-[0.14px]"
105:                                 >
106:                                     <Plus size={14} strokeWidth={2} />
107:                                     Add Bean
108:                                 </button>
109:                                 <BeanList
110:                                     beans={beans}
111:                                     isLoading={isLoading}
112:                                     selectedId={selected?.id ?? null}
113:                                     onSelect={setSelectedId}
114:                                     search={search}
115:                                     onSearchChange={setSearch}
116:                                 />
117:                             </div>
118:                             <BeanDetail
119:                                 bean={selected}
120:                                 isLoading={isLoading}
121:                                 onEdit={(bean) => openModal('edit', bean.id, bean)}
122:                                 onRestock={(id) => openModal('restock', id)}
123:                                 onStartRoast={() => {
124:                                     if (selected?.id) useRoastingStore.getState().setPendingBean(selected.id);
125:                                     onNavigate?.('roast');
126:                                 }}
127:                                 onDelete={(id) => {
128:                                     deleteBean(id, { onSuccess: () => setSelectedId(null) });
129:                                 }}
130:                             />
131:                         </div>
132:                     )}
133:                 </>
134:             )}
135: 
136:             {tab === 'blend' && <BlendList />}
137:         </PageLayout>
138:     );
139: };
</file>

 80: const fmtSec = (v: number) => {
 81:     const sign = v < 0 ? '-' : '';
 82:     const abs = Math.abs(v);
 83:     const m = Math.floor(abs / 60);
 84:     const s = Math.round(abs % 60);
 85:     return `${sign}${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
 86: };
 87: 
 88: /** Approximate perceived brightness of a hex color (0–255). */
 89: const luminance = (hex: string): number => {
 90:     const c = hex.replace('#', '');
 91:     if (c.length < 6) return 255;
 92:     const r = parseInt(c.substring(0, 2), 16);
 93:     const g = parseInt(c.substring(2, 4), 16);
 94:     const b = parseInt(c.substring(4, 6), 16);
 95:     return (r * 299 + g * 587 + b * 114) / 1000;
 96: };

843:             notMerge: structureChanged,

849:     // 마우스 호버
850:     useEffect(() => {
851:         const chart = chartInstanceRef.current;
852:         if (!chart || !onCursorIdx) return;
853: 
854:         // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
855:         const handleMouseMove = (e: any) => {
856:             const pixel: [number, number] = [e.offsetX, e.offsetY];
857:             const point = chart.convertFromPixel({ xAxisIndex: 0 }, pixel);
858:             if (point && xs.length) {
859:                 const idx = xs.reduce(
860:                     (prev, curr, i) => (Math.abs(curr - point[0]) < Math.abs(xs[prev] - point[0]) ? i : prev),
861:                     0,
862:                 );
863:                 onCursorIdx(idx);
864:             }
865:         };
866: 
867:         chart.on('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
868:         return () => {
869:             chart.off('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
870:         };
871:     }, [xs, onCursorIdx]);

873:     // ── 마커 드래그 (chart.getZr()로 마크라인 핸들 감지) ──────────
874:     useEffect(() => {
875:         const chart = chartInstanceRef.current;
876:         if (!chart || !onEventMarkerDrag) return;
877: 
878:         const zr = chart.getZr();
879:         if (!zr) return;
880: 
881:         const handleZrPointerDown = (e: Record<string, unknown>) => {
882:             if (!chart) return;
883:             const evt = e.event as MouseEvent | undefined;
884:             const mx = evt?.offsetX ?? (e.offsetX as number);
885:             if (mx == null) return;
886:             const yMid = (chart.convertToPixel({ yAxisIndex: 0 }, 150) as number) ?? 200;
887:             for (const marker of eventMarkers) {
888:                 const pixel = chart.convertToPixel({ xAxisIndex: 0 }, [marker.timeSec, yMid]);
889:                 if (pixel == null) continue;
890:                 const px = Array.isArray(pixel) ? pixel[0] : pixel;
891:                 const dist = Math.abs(mx - px);
892:                 if (dist <= PIXEL_THRESHOLD) {
893:                     dragStateRef.current = {
894:                         active: true,
895:                         eventName: marker.event,
896:                         startX: mx,
897:                         startTimeSec: marker.timeSec,
898:                     };
899:                     break;
900:                 }
901:             }
902:         };
903: 
904:         const handleZrPointerMove = (e: Record<string, unknown>) => {
905:             const ds = dragStateRef.current;
906:             if (!ds || !ds.active || !chart) return;
907:             const evt = e.event as MouseEvent | undefined;
908:             const mx = evt?.offsetX ?? (e.offsetX as number);
909:             const my = evt?.offsetY ?? (e.offsetY as number);
910:             if (mx == null) return;
911:             const point = chart.convertFromPixel({ xAxisIndex: 0 }, [mx, my]);
912:             if (!point) return;
913:             const xVal = Array.isArray(point) ? point[0] : point;
914:             const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.round(xVal));
915:             if (clamped !== ds.startTimeSec) {
916:                 onEventMarkerDrag(ds.eventName, clamped);
917:                 dragStateRef.current = { ...ds, startTimeSec: clamped };
918:             }
919:         };
920: 
921:         const handleZrPointerUp = () => {
922:             if (dragStateRef.current) {
923:                 dragStateRef.current = null;
924:             }
925:         };
926: 
927:         zr.on('mousedown', handleZrPointerDown);
928:         zr.on('mousemove', handleZrPointerMove);
929:         zr.on('mouseup', handleZrPointerUp);
930: 
931:         return () => {

 466:             }
 467:             return;
 468:         }

 470:         triggerCharge(rawBT);
 471:     }, [charged, rawBT, triggerCharge, setConnected, disableAutoCharge]);
 472: 
 473:     /** 로스팅을 처음 상태로 되돌린다. 사이드카가 연결되어 있으면 예열 단계로 재진입 */

 516:     };

 602:     const { devTimeStr, dtrPct } = useMemo(() => {

 614:     const { deltaBT, deltaET } = useMemo(() => {

 618:         const targetTime = current.time - 30;

 621:         );
 622:         if (past === current) return { deltaBT: null, deltaET: null };

 624:         const det =
 625:             current.et != null && past.et != null

 985:                     if (!user) return;
 986:                     const durationSeconds = elapsed;
 987:                     const roastedAt =
 988:                         roastStartTimeRef.current > 0 ? new Date(roastStartTimeRef.current).toISOString() : null;
 989: 
 990:                     try {
 991:                         let tsvPath: string | null = null;
 992:                         if (sessionId && '__TAURI_INTERNALS__' in window) {
 993:                             try {
 994:                                 const tsvContent = await readTextFile(`session_${sessionId}.tsv`, {
 995:                                     baseDir: BaseDirectory.AppLocalData,
 996:                                 });
 997:                                 const r2Key = `profiles/${user.id}/${sessionId}.tsv`;
 998:                                 const r2 = new S3Client({
 999:                                     region: 'auto',
1000:                                     endpoint: `https://${import.meta.env.VITE_R2_ACCOUNT_ID}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
1001:                                     credentials: {
1002:                                         accessKeyId: import.meta.env.VITE_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID,
1003:                                         secretAccessKey: import.meta.env.VITE_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY,
1004:                                     },
1005:                                 });
1006:                                 await r2.send(
1007:                                     new PutObjectCommand({
1008:                                         Bucket: import.meta.env.VITE_R2_BUCKET_NAME,
1009:                                         Key: r2Key,
1010:                                         Body: tsvContent,
1011:                                         ContentType: 'text/tab-separated-values',
1012:                                     }),
1013:                                 );
1014:                                 tsvPath = r2Key;
1015:                                 remove(`session_${sessionId}.tsv`, {
1016:                                     baseDir: BaseDirectory.AppLocalData,
1017:                                 }).catch(() => {});
1018:                             } catch {
1019:                                 // 파일이 없거나 업로드 실패 시 tsv_path 없이 저장 진행
1020:                             }
1021:                         }
1022: 
1023:                         const savedSession = await saveRoastSession({
1024:                             user_id: user.id,
1025:                             weight_grams: saveWeight,
1026:                             status: 'completed',
1027:                             roasted_at: roastedAt,
1028:                             duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
1029:                             drop_temp_celsius: rawBT != null ? Math.round(rawBT) : null,
1030:                             roast_level: saveLevel,
1031:                             scheduled_at: null,
1032:                             notes: notes || null,
1033:                             ambient_temp_celsius: weatherData?.temperature ?? null,
1034:                             ambient_humidity_pct: weatherData?.humidity ?? null,
1035:                             bean_id: selectedBeanId,
1036:                             profile_id: targetProfileId,
1037:                             tsv_path: tsvPath,
1038:                             plan_batch_id: planBatchHandoff?.planBatchId ?? null,
1039:                         });
1040:                         const stockDeductions: Promise<unknown>[] = [];
1041: 
1042:                         // 배치의 batchSizeKg 또는 사용자 입력 weightGrams 중 유효한 값 사용
1043:                         const deductionGrams = planBatchHandoff?.batchSizeKg
1044:                             ? Math.round(planBatchHandoff.batchSizeKg * 1000)
1045:                             : saveWeight > 0
1046:                               ? saveWeight
1047:                               : 0;
1048: 
1049:                         // 단일 생두 → bean_inventory_logs (배치 여부 관계없이 동작)
1050:                         if (selectedBeanId && deductionGrams > 0 && user) {
1051:                             stockDeductions.push(
1052:                                 createInventoryLog({
1053:                                     user_id: user.id,
1054:                                     bean_id: selectedBeanId,
1055:                                     change_grams: -deductionGrams,
1056:                                     type: 'roast',
1057:                                     roast_session_id: savedSession.id,
1058:                                 }),
1059:                             );
1060:                         }
1061: 
1062:                         // 블렌드 → bean_stock_events (각 구성 생두별 차감)
1063:                         if (deductionGrams > 0 && user && planBatchHandoff?.blendId) {
1064:                             try {
1065:                                 const blendWithComponents = await blendApi.get(planBatchHandoff.blendId);
1066:                                 const chargeGrams = deductionGrams;
1067:                                 for (const comp of blendWithComponents.blend_components) {
1068:                                     stockDeductions.push(
1069:                                         beanStockEventApi.insert({
1070:                                             user_id: user.id,
1071:                                             bean_id: comp.bean_id,
1072:                                             delta_grams: -Math.round(chargeGrams * (Number(comp.ratio_pct) / 100)),
1073:                                             event_type: 'roast',
1074:                                             reference_id: savedSession.id,
1075:                                             note: `${blendWithComponents.name} 블렌드 차감`,
1076:                                         }),
1077:                                     );
1078:                                 }
1079:                             } catch (err) {
1080:                                 console.error('[RoastSummary] blend stock deduction failed:', err);
1081:                             }
1082:                         }
1083: 
1084:                         // 배치 status 업데이트 (phantom 예약 방지)
1085:                         if (batchDone && planBatchHandoff) {
1086:                             stockDeductions.push(updatePlanBatch({ id: planBatchHandoff.planBatchId, status: 'done' }));
1087:                         }
1088: 
1089:                         await Promise.all(stockDeductions);
1090:                         setShowSummaryModal(false);
1091:                         setSummaryData(null);
1092:                         resetActiveRoast();
1093:                         if (planBatchHandoff) {
1094:                             setShowContinueModal(true);
1095:                         }
1096:                     } catch (err) {
1097:                         console.error('[RoastSummary] 저장 실패:', err);
1098:                         await message(`저장에 실패했습니다.\n\n${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`, {
1099:                             title: '저장 실패',
1100:                             kind: 'error',
1101:                         });
1102:                     }
1103:                 }}
1104:             />
1105: 
1106:             <PlanBatchContinueModal
1107:                 show={showContinueModal}
1108:                 planBatchHandoff={planBatchHandoff}
1109:                 batchDone={batchDone}
1110:                 sessionsAfter={sessionsAfter}
1111:                 onPlanBatchComplete={onPlanBatchComplete}
1112:                 onDismiss={() => setShowContinueModal(false)}
1113:             />
1114:         </div>
1115:     );
1116: };
